Clumsy, frustrating, yet deeply endearing — this coming-of-age ensemble drama of crisscrossing hearts marches on. As they grow closer, Koyuki and Minato begin to develop feelings for each other that go beyond mere friendship. Meanwhile, Youta finally confesses to Miki the feelings he's harbored for years. Clumsy, frustrante, pero profundamente apasionante — este drama que se acerca a la edad de los corazones cruzados avanza. A medida que se acercan, Koyuki y Minato comienzan a desarrollar sentimientos entre sí que van más allá de la mera amistad. airing.title: TETSURYO! Meet With Tetsudou Musume
airing.description: Misaki has often felt the urge to break free from everyday life and set out on a journey somewhere far away. Even though she doesn’t yet know what she wants to become, she longs to find something she can truly be passionate about. At the start of a new chapter on a lively campus, she meets the members of the Railway Travel Research Club—known as the “Tetsuryo Club.” As her world unfolds along the railway lines, Misaki’s heart begins to race with excitement! As TETSUDOU MUSUME celebrates its 20th anniversary, the Tetsuryo Club sets off on a journey through the world where the Railway Girls work, in search of moments of wonder. (Source: Pony Canyon Anime)
airing.description_es: Misaki ha sentido a menudo el impulso de liberarse de la vida cotidiana y de emprender un viaje lejos. A pesar de que todavía no sabe lo que quiere convertirse, ella desea encontrar algo que realmente pueda ser apasionada. Al comienzo de un nuevo capítulo en un animado campus, se reúne con los miembros del Club de Investigación de Viajes Ferroviarios, conocido como el Club Tetsuryo. Mientras su mundo se desarrolla a lo largo de las líneas ferroviarias, el corazón de Misaki comienza a correr con emoción! A medida que TETSUDOU MUSUME celebra su 20 aniversario, el Tetsuryo Club comienza en un viaje por el mundo donde trabajan las Ferrocarriles

airing.description: Born into a prestigious family of master swordsmen, Elymas Edvaughn’s future shatters when he awakens the so-called “defective” Heavy Knight class. Disowned and cast out, he regains memories of another life—and realizes this world mirrors a VR game he once mastered. Armed with knowledge no one else possesses, he sets out to rewrite his fate and prove the strength of the “weakest” class. (Source: Crunchyroll)
airing.description_es: Elymas Edvaughn nace en una prestigiosa familia de maestros espadachines, pero su futuro se derrumba cuando despierta la clase de Caballero Pesado, considerada defectuosa. Rechazado y expulsado, recupera recuerdos de una vida anterior y descubre que ese mundo se parece a un videojuego de realidad virtual que conocía muy bien. Gracias a secretos que nadie más posee, decide cambiar su destino y demostrar el verdadero poder de la clase que todos consideran la más débil.

airing.title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World II
airing.description: Once dismissed as the sole ordinary student at the elite Arnold Academy of Sorcery, Ray White—secretly, the Iceblade Sorcerer—has finally earned his place. With a new school year comes a new challenge: The Magicks War, a grand competition pitting teams from rival schools against each other. But an ominous shadow looms over Ray and his friends as the other grand sorcerers plot their next moves. (Source: Crunchyroll)
airing.description_es: Una vez despedido como el único estudiante ordinario de la élite Arnold Academy of Sorcery, Ray White — secretamente, el Hechicero de Iceblade— finalmente ha ganado su lugar. Con un nuevo año escolar surge un nuevo desafío: La Guerra de los Magos, una gran competencia que enfrenta equipos de escuelas rivales entre sí. Pero una sombra ominosa sobre Ray y sus amigos mientras los otros grandes hechiceros trazan sus próximos movimientos. (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

airing.description: The story of Aoki Denshou Welsh & Shedar follows Welsh, a teenage boy from the country who loves to cook, and Shedar, a young prince who is destined to become king one day. When the two young men with very different lives are thrown together by a chance encounter, the wheels of fate begin to turn, and soon they must work together to bring about a peaceful future by stopping a cruel despot from conquering the world. (Source: Crunchyroll)
airing.description_es: La historia de Aoki Denshou Welsh " Shedar sigue a Welsh, un adolescente del país que ama cocinar, y a Shedar, un joven príncipe que está destinado a ser rey un día. Cuando los dos jóvenes con vidas muy diferentes son lanzados juntos por un encuentro casual, las ruedas del destino comienzan a girar, y pronto deben trabajar juntos para traer un futuro pacífico al detener un cruel déspota de conquistar el mundo. (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

airing.description: This is a story of four girls living in the "Dark Side" of Academy City. In Academy City where "ESP" has been recognized as a general science. Takitsubo Rikou is able to read and track the AIM fields emitted by those with abilities. Frenda Seivelun, who excels in combat using explosives and traps. Kinuhata Saiai, who can manipulate nitrogen at will and plays a defensive role. And one of the 7 Espers that Academy City is proud of: Mugino Shizuri. They live freely in the darkness of the Academy City, and quietly set their sights on their target...! This is a story of encounter, friendship, and darkness that eventually leads to a terrible incident! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

airing.description: In the aftermath of the Shi Clan’s rebellion, things have finally settled down, and Maomao has returned to her old life as a pharmacist in the pleasure district. Meanwhile, Jinshi, who has revealed his true identity as the Imperial brother and begun to face his heavy responsibilities, is deeply troubled by the final message left by Loulan: a warning of an impending "disaster that will strike the nation." To make matters worse, rumors of a mysterious shrine maiden who deceives the people begin to spread, casting a dark shadow over the country of Li once again. Before she can secure a marriage that will redeem her worth in her family’s eyes, she finds herself the target of the mysterious assassin Shinpei, and her plans are put in jeopardy. In order to save herself, she makes a desperate proposal—of marriage! When it comes to love, however, Shinpei takes “until death do we part” seriously. (Source: VIZ Media)

airing.title: TOUGEN ANKI: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc
airing.description: After battling in Kyoto and Nerima, the Rasetsu Academy students have grown stronger. But Yaoroshi leaves the academy to join the Oni Brigade for their "the total eradication of the Momotaro." When Shiki realizes that they also target noncombatants, he sets out after Yaoroshi to bring him back. Meanwhile in Nikko, there's a research facility for horrific experiments atop the old Kegon Falls… (Source: REMOW)
airing.description_es: Después de luchar en Kioto y Nerima, los estudiantes de la Academia Rasetsu se han hecho más fuertes. Pero Yaoroshi deja la academia para unirse a la Brigada Oni por su "erración total del Momotaro". Cuando Shiki se da cuenta de que también apuntan a los no combatientes, se pone después de Yaoroshi para traerlo de vuelta. Mientras tanto, en Nikko, hay una instalación de investigación para experimentos horribles en la antigua Kegon Falls... (Fuente: REMOW)

airing.title: Please Excuse My Younger Brothers
airing.description: The manga centers on high school student Ito Hazui. During her spring break at the end of her first year of high school, Ito's mother remarries, and Ito moves to live with her new family, becoming Ito Narita. Upon arriving at her new house, Ito is shocked to learn she now has four younger step-brothers. Ito tries her hardest to get along with all of the new members of her family, but the eldest brother Gen is a bit cold to her. However, under his aloof facade, he occasionally shows his kindness. (Source: Anime News Network)
airing.description_es: El manga se centra en el estudiante de secundaria Ito Hazui. Durante su descanso de primavera al final de su primer año de secundaria, la madre de Ito se vuelve a casar, y Ito se mueve a vivir con su nueva familia, convirtiéndose en Ito Narita. Al llegar a su nueva casa, Ito está sorprendido de saber que ahora tiene cuatro hermanos menores. Ito trata de que ella sea más difícil de llevar con todos los nuevos miembros de su familia, pero el hermano mayor Gen es un poco frío para ella. Sin embargo, bajo su fachada, ocasionalmente muestra su amabilidad. (Fuente: Anime News Network)

airing.description: Everyday life gets a cozy twist with the laid-back Rilakkuma. Gentle moments of friendship, change, and small joys unfold, turning ordinary moments into something quietly magical—one soft, comforting day at a time. It's a moment that will make your heart feel lighter and lighter. No matter where you are or what you're doing, Rilakkuma will be by your side. An exciting new story begins! Experience the stress-free world of Rilakkuma, the relaxed bear who makes being lazy look effortless! (Source: Crunchyroll, Rilakkuma Anime Site, translated)
airing.description_es: Cada día la vida recibe un toque acogedor con el relajado Rilakkuma. Los momentos suaves de amistad, cambio y las pequeñas alegrías se desarrollan, convirtiendo los momentos ordinarios en algo silenciosamente mágico — un día suave y reconfortante a la vez. Es un momento que hará que su corazón se sienta más ligero y más ligero. No importa dónde estés o lo que estés haciendo, Rilakkuma estará a tu lado. ¡Una nueva historia emocionante comienza! ¡Experimente el mundo libre de estrés de Rilakkuma, el oso relajado que hace ser perezoso sin esfuerzo! (Fuente: Crunchyroll, Rilakkuma Anime Site, traducido)

With the invasion of the Netherworld, both humans and Netherworld beings wreak havoc on the mortal world, and the wild gods who work for the Netherworld bully the common people. Enraged, Xu Ying, a snake-catcher, rebels and commits the sin of killing a god, and also takes out an incompetent court official. Hunted down by the two realms, his fleeing begins... (Source: iQ)

Con la invasión del Netherworld, los seres humanos y el Netherworld causaron estragos en el mundo mortal, y los dioses salvajes que trabajan para el Netherworld intimidan al pueblo común. Enfurecido, Xu Ying, un cazador de serpientes, rebelde y comete el pecado de matar a un dios, y también saca a un funcionario de la corte incompetente. Cazado por los dos reinos, su huida comienza... (Fuente: iQ)

airing.title: Soul Land 2: The Peerless Tang Clan
airing.description: The Tang Sect in a turbulent world. There is nothing but martial spirit here. Ten thousand years after the founding of the Tang Sect, it is in relative decline. An extremely talented man was born. Can the new Shrek Seven Monsters revive the Tang Sect and bring it back to glory? A soul beast of over one million years old; Electrolux who can pick stars; The new soul utensil system that led to the decline of the Tang Sect... A lot of secrets are to be revealed. Can the secret weapons of the Tang Sect be sharp again? Can the Tang Sect regain its former glory? (Source: WeTV)
airing.description_es: El Tang Sect en un mundo turbulento. Aquí no hay nada más que espíritu marcial. Diez mil años después de la fundación del Tang Sect, está en declive relativo. Nació un hombre extremadamente talentoso. ¿Pueden los nuevos Monstruos Shrek revivir el Tang Sect y traerlo de vuelta a la gloria? Una bestia de alma de más de un millón de años; Electrolux que puede elegir estrellas; El nuevo sistema de utensilios de alma que llevó al declive del Tang Sect... Hay que revelar muchos secretos. ¿Pueden volver a afilarse las armas secretas del Tang Sect? ¿Puede el Tang Sect recuperar su antigua gloria? (Fuente: WeTV)

The shorts will stream monthly on various social media services such as Twitter, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok, as well as on ABEMA. (Source: Anime News Network, edited)

airing.title: Shin Chan
airing.description: Crayon Shin-chan follows the wacky antics and adventures of five-year-old Shinnosuke "Shin" Nohara and his parents, neighbors, and friends and is set in Kasukabe, Saitama Prefecture, Japan. Many of the jokes in the series stem from Shin-chan's occasionally weird, unnatural and inappropriate use of language, as well as from his inappropriate behavior. A typical gag involves Shin-chan confounding his parents by using the wrong phrase for the occasion; for example, saying "Welcome back!" instead of "I am back!" when he comes home. During the beginning of the series, the TV show was mostly based on the storyline in the original manga. As the show progressed, more and more episodes became anime-original.

airing.title: The Vermilion Mask
airing.description: "The Mask” gives power to anyone who wears it. At times, that means endless possibility, or unimaginable tragedy… Peru, pupil of the legendary mask maker Gaston Roux, becomes controlled by the “Mask of the Warrior God,” and unintentionally kills his friends, and even his own master. In order to prevent this type of tragedy from reoccurring, Peru swears to destroy all of Gaston’s masks that are spread around the world. Confronting the sins that he has committed, he embarks on his voyage. Meeting new friends, then confronting powerful foes. The boy continues on. Until the day he can atone for his sins against his master. (Source: The Vermillion Mask English Site)
airing.description_es: "La máscara" da poder a cualquiera que la use. A veces, eso significa una posibilidad interminable, o una tragedia inimaginable... Perú, alumno del legendario fabricante de máscaras Gaston Roux, se hace controlado por el “Mask del Dios Guerrero”, y mata involuntariamente a sus amigos, e incluso a su propio maestro. Para evitar que este tipo de tragedia vuelva a ocurrir, Perú jura destruir todas las máscaras de Gaston que se extienden alrededor del mundo. Frente a los pecados que ha cometido, se embarca en su viaje. Conocer a nuevos amigos y enfrentar a poderosos enemigos. El chico continúa. Hasta el día que puede expiar por hola

airing.title: Detective Conan
airing.description: Kudo Shinichi is a seventeen year-old high school detective whom people call the "Modern Sherlock Holmes." However, one night after a date with his childhood sweetheart, Ran, Shinichi witnessed an illegal trade and, caught off his guard, was knocked unconscious and fed a drug that was supposed to kill him... but he woke up and found himself shrunken to a seven year-old. In order to track down the men who did this to him, Shinichi hid his identity and lived with Ran, whose father happened to be a hopeless detective, and with that came a series of murders and mysteries that he must solve. (Source: Anime News Network) Note: - Includes Keisatsu Gakkou-hen - Wild Police Story in episodes 1029, 1038, 1042, 1061 - Episodes 11, 52, 76, 118, 162, 184, 208, 342, 356, 449, 452, 487, 488, 489, 490, 515, 516, 521, 522, 651, 734, 804, 805, 927, 928, 1187 aired with a runtime of ~50 minutes as opposed to the standard 25 minute long episode. - Episodes 96, 129, 174, 219, 263, 304, 383, 479 aired with a runtime of ~90 minutes as opposed to the standard 25 minute long episode. - Episode 345, 425 aired with a runtime of ~115 minutes as opposed to the standard 25 minute long episode.
airing.description_es: Kudo Shinichi es un detective de secundaria de diecisiete años a quien la gente llama "Modern Sherlock Holmes". Sin embargo, una noche después de una cita con su novia de la infancia, Ran, Shinichi fue testigo de un comercio ilegal y, atrapado de su guardia, fue noqueado inconsciente y alimentado una droga que se suponía que lo mataría... pero se despertó y se encontró a sí mismo hundido a un niño de siete años. Para localizar a los hombres que le hicieron esto, Shinichi escondió su identidad y vivió con Ran, cuyo padre fue un detective sin esperanza, y con eso llegó una serie de asesinatos y misterios que él debe resolver. (Sourc)

airing.title: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom
airing.description: At the heart of a continent of eight kingdoms lies the Marronnier Kingdom. Its general, Baribara, has seven sons, each with a unique gift and serving as a knight commander. Bound by a single noble cause of heroically rescuing a princess someday, the brothers set out as goodwill ambassadors to the seven neighboring kingdoms. What encounters, trials, and destinies await them in these unknown lands? (Source: Amazon Prime Video)
airing.description_es: En el corazón de un continente de ocho reinos se encuentra el Reino Marronnier. Su general, Baribara, tiene siete hijos, cada uno con un regalo único y servir como comandante caballero. Heridos por una única causa noble de rescatar heroicamente a una princesa algún día, los hermanos se establecieron como embajadores de buena voluntad a los siete reinos vecinos. ¿Qué encuentros, pruebas y destinos les esperan en estas tierras desconocidas? (Fuente: Amazon Prime Video)

airing.description: Romelia and her party succeed in defeating the Demon King Zelgis, though Prince Henri’s reckless charge forces them into a grueling battle. In the aftermath, Romelia is branded "dead weight" for not fighting directly, and the Prince unilaterally breaks off their engagement. Denied a place in the victory celebrations, Romelia returns home, only to be met with cold indifference from her family and society. Yet, she refuses to break. She has already set her sights on the path that lies ahead. (Source: Crunchyroll) Note: Romelia War Chronicle was streamed 2 days in advance of the TV broadcast on AnimeTimes, U-NEXT, and Netflix beginning October 3, 2026. Regular broadcasting began on October 5, 2026.
airing.description_es: Romelia y su partido tienen éxito en derrotar al Rey demonio Zelgis, aunque la carga imprudente del príncipe Henri los obliga a una batalla agotadora. Después, Romelia se marca "peso muerto" por no luchar directamente, y el Príncipe unilateralmente rompe su compromiso. Denegado un lugar en las celebraciones de la victoria, Romelia vuelve a casa, sólo para ser conocido con indiferencia fría de su familia y sociedad. Sin embargo, se niega a romper. Ella ya ha puesto sus ojos en el camino que está por delante. (Fuente: Crunchyroll) Nota: Romelia War Chronicle fue transmitido 2 días antes de la emisión de televisión en A

airing.title: A Tale of the Secret Saint
airing.description: Fia always dreamed of becoming a knight. Born into a family of knights, she’s the least talented among them, but she still clutches to her hope and trains with everything she has. When the day comes for her to slay a small demon and prove her worth, she ends up face to face with a dragon instead! A deadly injury makes her life flash before her eyes…and she suddenly remembers her former life, when she was a powerful Saint in a bygone era who defeated the Demon King. That life ended in pain because of who she was, making her fear ever becoming a Saint again. Now that the magic from her previous life has been rekindled, she may become a more powerful knight than she ever dreamed–if only she can survive long enough! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: The series streamed a week in advance on ABEMA, Prime Video, and Crunchyroll starting with episode 2 released alongside episode 1.
airing.description_es: Fia siempre soñó con convertirse en un caballero. Nacida en una familia de caballeros, es la menos talentosa entre ellos, pero todavía se aferra a su esperanza y trenes con todo lo que tiene. Cuando llega el día para que mate a un pequeño demonio y pruebe su valor, termina cara a cara con un dragón en su lugar! Una herida mortal hace que su vida parpadee ante sus ojos... y de repente recuerda su vida anterior, cuando era un poderoso santo en una era pasada que venció al Rey demonio. airing.description_es: ¡La segunda temporada de Yasei no el último jefe ga Arawareta!

airing.title: Black Clover Season 2
airing.description: As tyranny engulfs the Clover Kingdom, Asta and the Magic Knights launch a desperate raid on the Spade Kingdom to rescue their squad captains from the Dark Triad. But their mission leads them into a brutal battle against forces beyond anything they’ve ever faced. Now, Asta must rise above impossible odds to protect his friends and honor the promise he made to Yuno. (Source: Crunchyroll)
airing.description_es: A medida que la tiranía envuelve el Reino de Clover, Asta y los Caballeros Mágicos lanzan una redada desesperada en el Reino de Spade para rescatar a sus capitanes de la Tribu Oscura. Pero su misión los lleva a una batalla brutal contra las fuerzas más allá de cualquier cosa que hayan enfrentado. Ahora, Asta debe elevarse por encima de las probabilidades imposibles de proteger a sus amigos y honrar la promesa que hizo a Yuno. (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

airing.title: VERTEX FORCE
airing.description: Akira lives a peaceful life with his older sister Haruka and his mother, who runs a cafe. The family however harbors a secret — Haruka has inherited a power from her father called "Engine," and she hides that power from others. Akira on the other hand has not inherited his father's power, and he has an inferiority complex about it. Amidst this, strange events start happening around the world. (Source: Anime News Network)
airing.description_es: Akira vive una vida pacífica con su hermana mayor Haruka y su madre, que dirige un café. Sin embargo, la familia alberga un secreto — Haruka ha heredado un poder de su padre llamado "Engine", y esconde ese poder de otros. Akira, por otro lado, no ha heredado el poder de su padre, y tiene un complejo de inferioridad. En medio de esto, acontecimientos extraños comienzan a suceder alrededor del mundo. (Fuente: Anime News Network)

airing.title: #I'm Looking For a Zombie
airing.description: It may be a ruined city ravaged by zombies, but to Aki and her friends, it’s amazing! Having grown up only hearing stories of the old world and the mysterious outbreak that wiped out humanity, she sets off with her childhood friends in search of her missing father. Things quickly become a fight for survival outside the safety of their small village, yet they’ve never felt more alive. (Source: Crunchyroll)
airing.description_es: Puede ser una ciudad arruinada devastada por zombis, pero para Aki y sus amigos, ¡es increíble! Habiendo crecido sólo escuchando historias del viejo mundo y el misterioso brote que borró a la humanidad, se pone con sus amigos de la infancia en busca de su padre desaparecido. Las cosas se convierten rápidamente en una lucha por la supervivencia fuera de la seguridad de su pequeño pueblo, sin embargo nunca se han sentido más vivos. (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

airing.title: HORROR COLLECTOR
airing.description: Urban legends come to life…Everyone’s heard an urban legend before, but few have ever come face-to-face with one. These phenomena are everywhere, existing in the shadows of reality. More and more of them have been appearing in the wake of the faceless kid sighted all over Japan. If you see her or one of the urban legends she brings―pray the boy in the red hood finds you before it’s too late. You won’t stand a chance on your own. But with his help, you may just live to see another day… (Source: Yen Press)
airing.description_es: Las leyendas urbanas cobran vida... Todos han oído una leyenda urbana antes, pero pocos han llegado cara a cara con uno. Estos fenómenos están en todas partes, existentes en las sombras de la realidad. Cada vez más de ellos han estado apareciendo a raíz del niño sin rostro visto por todo Japón. Si la ves o una de las leyendas urbanas que trae, ora al chico en la capucha roja te encuentra antes de que sea demasiado tarde. Usted no tendrá una oportunidad por su cuenta. Pero con su ayuda, puedes vivir para ver otro día... (Fuente: Yen Press)

airing.title: Magical Explorer
airing.description: Few titles are more revered among horndogs-(ahem) connoisseurs of Japanese erotic video games-than Magical Explorer. One day, our smut-loving hero wakes up to find he has been reincarnated into the body of the game’s dreamboat protagonist! Or rather, his hapless comic-relief best friend, Kousuke Takioto. But with his unparalleled knowledge of Magical Explorer and Kousuke’s unorthodox abilities (a scarf that doubles as a fist?), our hero vows to turn the game’s unluckiest loser into its mightiest heartthrob. In this world, nothing is out of reach when you’ve got the know-how! (Source: Yen Press) Note: Each episode streamed 1 week early on ABEMA and d anime store. The original TV broadcast started on October 4th, 2026.
airing.description_es: Pocos títulos son más venerados entre los erizos-(ahem) conocedores de videojuegos eróticos japoneses-que Magical Explorer. Un día, nuestro héroe amante de la mugre se despierta para encontrar que ha sido reencarnado en el cuerpo del protagonista de la lancha del juego! O más bien, su mejor amigo, Kousuke Takioto. Pero con su inigualable conocimiento de Magical Explorer y las habilidades de Kousuke poco ortodoxas (una bufanda que se dobla como un puño?), nuestro héroe promete convertir el perdedor más desafortunado del juego en su corazón más poderoso. En este mundo, nada está fuera de alcance cuando tienes el know-how! (Fuente: Yen Press

airing.title: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
airing.description: This is Fujinasu Academy, a private high school with top-achieving students located on the outskirts of town. High School 1st-Year Ume Mizunoe has excellent grades in Japanese language class and has received multiple literary awards. However, his terrible grades in the sciences are affecting his ability to move up a grade. To avoid repeating a year, he becomes a member of the student council to improve his academic standing. However, in the student council, he meets the charismatic yet sullen student council president Kotobuki Hisako, and the scary yet kind and refined treasurer, Arisu Terui. Other members include a cheeky and cute boy, Tan Otori, and Komaro Michinoku, the admin who's like a small abandoned cat. This is the start of a slapstick, heartful, rom-com about a busy student council full of cute, mismatched, and quirky students! (Source: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! Official Site)
airing.description_es: Esta es la Academia Fujinasu, una escuela secundaria privada con estudiantes de primer nivel ubicados en las afueras de la ciudad. Sin embargo, sus calificaciones terribles en las ciencias están afectando su capacidad de avanzar en un grado. airing.description: If there's one thing you can never have enough of in a world of RPG-style swords and sorcery, it's magic points! Whether you're fueling spells, techniques, or showing off an incredible ability, you've gotta spend those points to do real damage. But what if you run out? Lent is part of the up-and-coming party known as the “Skypiercers,” and thanks to his unique Gift, he can loan massive amounts of magic to others. No MP? No problem with Lent around! Except, now that his companions have become formidable heroes (thanks to his skill), his usefulness is questioned. Kicked out of the group, Lent is furious…until he discovers a hidden power to his Gift. Now, with his adorably devious fairy partner, he's going to claw back every last scrap of magic from his former party—with interest! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

airing.description: Gakken's hugely popular illustrated encyclopedia series, which everyone can enjoy with its laid-back four-panel comics, is finally being adapted into a TV anime! Discover surprising aspects and fun facts about living creatures—full of secrets that will make you say, "Wow!" Enjoy this new kind of anime that makes even scary things fun and easy to watch, with its cute art style. (Source: Official Site, translated)
airing.description_es: La popular y popular serie de enciclopedias ilustradas de Gakken, que todos pueden disfrutar con sus cómics de cuatro paneles, finalmente se está adaptando a un anime de televisión! Descubre aspectos sorprendentes y hechos divertidos sobre los seres vivientes, llenos de secretos que te harán decir: "¡Wow!" Disfruta de este nuevo tipo de anime que hace que las cosas aterradoras sean divertidas y fáciles de ver, con su estilo de arte lindo. (Fuente: Sitio oficial, traducido)

airing.title: Raccoon Dog & Fox
airing.description: The story centers on the daily lives of a raccoon dog who is not quite with it and a mischievous fox who likes to tease the raccoon dog. The two are close friends who live together on a mountain. Their other friends include a wolf, a bear, a rabbit, and birds. (Source: Anime News Network)
airing.description_es: La historia se centra en la vida diaria de un perro de mapache que no está bien con él y un zorro malicioso que le gusta burlar al perro de mapache. Los dos son amigos cercanos que viven juntos en una montaña. Sus otros amigos incluyen un lobo, un oso, un conejo y aves. (Fuente: Anime News Network)

Surrounded by elite players like Kuribayashi and Akutsu, practices are just as merciless as the matches. In this U-18 Premier League of powerhouse talent, Ashito must evolve or be crushed, if he’s ever to be acknowledged. (Source: Crunchyroll)
airing.description_es: El juego de Aoi Ashito ahora le ha ganado un lugar en el equipo A, pero rápidamente está abrumado por su dura nueva realidad. Rodeado de jugadores de élite como Kuribayashi y Akutsu, las prácticas son tan misericordiosos como los partidos. En esta U-18 Premier League de talento de la central eléctrica, Ashito debe evolucionar o ser aplastado, si alguna vez es reconocido. (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

airing.title: Ace of the Diamond act II -Second Season-
airing.description: The Seido baseball club has been invited to the spring invitational at the hallowed Koshien Stadium. Sawamura will finally stand on the mound! Standing between Seido and the national title are the winners of last year's summer tournament Komadai Fujimaki and their unstoppable ace Masamune Hongo. Can Seido triumph over Komadai? It's the start of another heated battle in youth baseball! (Source: Crunchyroll)
airing.description_es: El club de béisbol Seido ha sido invitado a la invitación de primavera en el sagrado estadio Koshien. ¡Sawamura finalmente estará en el montículo! De pie entre Seido y el título nacional son los ganadores del torneo de verano del año pasado Komadai Fujimaki y su imparable as Masamune Hongo. ¿Puede ser Seido triunfar sobre Komadai? ¡Es el comienzo de otra batalla calentada en el béisbol juvenil! (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

airing.title: Holo no Graffiti
airing.description: From unraveling the secrets of opening and closing doors to defusing surprise packages more commonly known as bombs, there is never a dull day at the Hololive Production office! Holo no Graffiti follows an eccentric cast of Virtual YouTubers, also known as "VTubers," going about their absurd yet hilarious daily lives, detailing all their cute moments and mishaps. (Source: MAL Rewrite)
airing.description_es: ¡Desvelar los secretos de abrir y cerrar puertas para desactivar paquetes sorpresa más conocidos como bombas, nunca hay un día aburrido en la oficina de producción Hololive! Holo no Graffiti sigue un elenco excéntrico de YouTubers Virtuales, también conocido como "VTubers", pasando por sus absurdas pero hilarantes vidas diarias, detallando todos sus momentos y agitaciones. (Fuente: MAL Rewrite)

airing.title: Sazae-san
airing.description: The main character is a mother named Sazae-san. She lives in a house with her husband, her kid, her siblings and her parents. The show is the ultimate family program and tends to follow traditional themes. Think of this show as the Japanese equivalent to "The Partridge Family" and you'll get a good feel for this show's atmosphere. Don't expect to see things like violence, swearing, kung-fu action or magical girls. The plots are more like "Today, Sazae-san goes to the new mall and gets lost". Such "boring" plotlines and the simplistic art are often a turn-off to non-Japanese audiences, but most Japanese find the show incredibly good. As a result, it continues to be one of the top ratings grabbers on TV and is one of the few anime that is considered "acceptable" by adults.
airing.description_es: El personaje principal es una madre llamada Sazae-san. Vive en una casa con su marido, su hijo, sus hermanos y sus padres. El espectáculo es el último programa familiar y tiende a seguir los temas tradicionales. Piense en este espectáculo como el equivalente japonés a "The Partridge Family" y obtendrá una buena sensación para la atmósfera de este show. airing.title: Umayuru: Full Gate!
airing.description: "Umayuru" is a short anime series featuring pint-sized Uma Musume! This time, it’s a "Full-Gate" three-minute race where *all* the Uma Musume take to the track! A super-sized, laid-back gathering with everyone!
airing.description_es: "Umayuru" es una serie corta de animes que ofrece un musgo de Uma tamaño pint! Esta vez, es una carrera de tres minutos "Full-Gate" donde *all* el Uma Musume to the track! ¡Una reunión súper grande y relajada con todos!

airing.title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
airing.description: Sato Takahiro was an ordinary office worker and hobbyist gamer until the day he woke up on a spaceship–one that strangely resembled a craft from a favorite space-shooter game. With a decked-out ship, a crew full of babes, and a fantastic universe to explore, he's going to make the most of his good luck and create the life he's always dreamed of! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
airing.description_es: Sato Takahiro era un trabajador de oficina ordinario y aficionado al juego hasta el día en que se despertó en una nave espacial – una que extrañamente se parecía a una nave de un juego favorito de tiro espacial. Con un barco desguace, una tripulación llena de chicas, y un universo fantástico para explorar, él va a aprovechar al máximo su buena suerte y crear la vida que siempre ha soñado con! (Fuente: Seven Seas Entertainment)

airing.title: Uncle's Obsession with Cute Things
airing.description: By day, Mitsutaka Oji is the handsome, dependable boss everyone admires. By night, he dotes on his favorite mascot, Pugtaro, and indulges his secret obsession with all things cute! He's kept his double life hidden for years—but one unexpected encounter turns everything upside down and forces Oji to face his feelings head-on! (Source: Crunchyroll)
airing.description_es: Al día, Mitsutaka Oji es el guapo y confiable jefe que todos admiran. Por la noche, hace su mascota favorita, Pugtaro, y complace su obsesión secreta con todas las cosas lindas! Ha mantenido su doble vida escondida durante años, pero un encuentro inesperado lo vuelve todo al revés y obliga a Oji a enfrentar sus sentimientos. (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

airing.title: TANK CHAIR
airing.description: Shizuka takes on the most dangerous of assassin jobs, but she's not the one doing the killing. Rather, it's her brother, Nagi, a strong assassin who took a bullet to protect his sister, leaving him in a comatose state and having to use a wheelchair. However, Shizuka has figured out the key to waking her brother up: he must be faced with killing intent! Thus begins a violent journey of recovery, battling the most dangerous foes! (Source: Kodansha USA)
airing.description_es: Shizuka se ocupa de los trabajos más peligrosos de los asesinos, pero ella no es la que hace el asesinato. Más bien, es su hermano, Nagi, un asesino fuerte que tomó una bala para proteger a su hermana, dejarlo en estado en coma y tener que usar una silla de ruedas. Sin embargo, Shizuka ha descubierto la clave para despertar a su hermano: ¡debe enfrentarse con la intención de matar! Así comienza un viaje violento de recuperación, luchando contra los enemigos más peligrosos! (Fuente: Kodansha USA)

airing.title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus
airing.description: Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep. Even Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus's overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku. Targeted by Beerus, the strongest being in the universe, Earth is in grave danger. Thus begins an earth-shattering cosmic battle between the God of Destruction and Goku and his alliesa—a conflict that will shake the entire universe. (Source: Official Site) Note: “Enhanced” edition of Dragon Ball Super, featuring a large volume of newly added and redrawn cuts, a reconstructed narrative, and updated visuals for a more immersive and faithful representation of Akira Toriyama’s original manga.
airing.description_es: Han pasado varios años desde la feroz batalla contra Majin Buu, y la Tierra finalmente ha recuperado un breve momento de paz. Al mismo tiempo, Beerus, el Dios de la Destrucción, despierta de su sueño largo y profundo. Incluso Kai y el Supremo Kai, consciente del abrumador poder de Beerus para destruir planetas enteros, ver su despertar con gran miedo... Mientras tanto, Beerus escucha rumores de un Saiyan que venció a Frieza y de repente aparece ante Goku. Meta de cerveza

airing.description_es: El jugador de RPG Makoto Takatsuki es lanzado en otro mundo con terribles habilidades y estadísticas. Pero pronto se encuentra con una diosa llamada Noé, que le pide que se convierta en su primer creyente a cambio de bendiciones. (Fuente: J-Novel Club)

airing.title: Even Though I'm a Super Timid Noble Girl, I Accepted the Bet From My Cunning Fiancé
airing.description: I was reborn as a villainous daughter in a reverse harem otome game. After being sick with a high fever at the age of 10, Pia Rockwell suddenly remembered her past life as a university student in Japan. But far from going down the villainess route, all this super timid girl wants is to finally use her knowledge from when she was a grad student studying to get her doctorate in paleontology. Her ultimate goal is to become a commoner, excavate fossils, build a museum and then become a curator. So in order to escape the villainess route and avoid being deported by her fiancé during the graduation ball, Pia decides to avoid the upcoming hurt and heartache and asks to break off her engagement to Rufus, the Prime Minister's son. But will her cunning fiancé let her go that easily?
airing.description_es: Renací como una hija villana en un juego de harem otome inverso. Después de enfermarse con fiebre alta a los 10 años, Pia Rockwell de repente recordó su vida pasada como estudiante universitaria en Japón. Pero lejos de ir por la ruta del villano, todo lo que esta chica súper tímida quiere es finalmente utilizar su conocimiento de cuando era una estudiante de posgrado que estudiaba para obtener su doctorado en paleontología. Su objetivo final es convertirse en un común, excavar fósiles, construir un museo y luego convertirse en un curador. Así que para escapar de la ruta del villano y evitar ser deportado por su prometido durante la graduación

Grid resolves to use his new abilities to achieve fame and fortune, but as his very existence begins to stir up trouble in Satisfy, he realizes that life as a legend may be more than he bargained for…. airing.title: From Far Away
airing.description: On her way home from school one day, Noriko is unexpectedly plunged into a strange and extraordinary fantasy world. Her troubles compound exponentially when she is rescued and befriended by a handsome young man by the name of Izark. He may be brave and courageous, but inside Izark lurks the darkest evil imaginable. And according to an ancient prophecy, Noriko possesses the power to unleash that evil. Now, inexorably bound together, these two unlikely allies must navigate a world both wondrous and hostile. (Source: VIZ Media)
airing.description_es: En su camino a casa desde la escuela un día, Noriko se sumergió inesperadamente en un extraño y extraordinario mundo de fantasía. Sus problemas se complican exponencialmente cuando es rescatada y amigada por un joven guapo por el nombre de Izark. Puede ser valiente y valiente, pero dentro de Izark se esconde el mal más oscuro imaginable. Y según una profecía antigua, Noriko posee el poder de desencadenar ese mal. Ahora, inexorablemente unidos, estos dos aliados improbables deben navegar por un mundo maravilloso y hostil. (Fuente: VIZ Media)

airing.title: Now That I Can Control Reality With A Mouse Cursor, I'm Gonna Click Away On The Girls!
airing.description: What if you could control reality with a mouse cursor? One day during class, Takumi— an otaku — notices his mouse cursor has sprung out of the screen. Panicked, he asks his childhood friend Mone, sitting next to him, to take a look, only to be brushed off... Once Takumi realizes he could actually control it himself, he uses the mouse cursor— visible only to him— to slip it in between Mone's clothes and starts clicking away... Here's Japan’s (probably) first new genre of romcom, "Clicking Away at a Gyaru Who's Mean to Otakus with a Mouse Cursor"! (Source: Official Site) Note: Episode 1 receives an advanced distribution on AnimeFesta on September 11th, 2026. The start date reflects the start of the regular series broadcasting.
airing.description_es: ¿Y si pudiera controlar la realidad con un cursor del ratón? Un día durante la clase, Takumi, un otaku, nota que el cursor del ratón ha salido de la pantalla. Panicked, pide a su amigo de la infancia Mone, sentado junto a él, para echar un vistazo, sólo para ser cepillado... Una vez que Takumi se da cuenta de que podía controlarlo él mismo, utiliza el cursor del ratón — visible sólo para él— para deslizarlo entre la ropa de Mone y empieza a hacer clic... Aquí está Japón (probablemente) primer nuevo género de romcom, "Haciendo clic en Away en un Gyaru Who's Mean a Otakus con un cursor Mouse"! (Fuente: Sitio Oficial) Nota: Episodio 1 recibe

airing.title: My Girlfriend's Friend

airing.title: I'm Dating a Dark Summoner
airing.description: Amona’s a dark summoner with demonic powers. Roni’s a devout priest who’s way too uptight. By all rights, they should hate each other. Instead, they end up fast-tracking their enemies-to-lovers arc with a one-night stand that somehow insists on becoming a recurring event. Now they must hide their situationship from the rest of the party while denying their growing attraction to one another, all while dealing with an imp who’s far too invested in their love life. (Source: HIDIVE)
airing.description_es: Amona es un llamador oscuro con poderes demoníacos. Roni es un sacerdote devota que está demasiado tenso. Por todos los derechos, deben odiarse. En lugar de eso, terminan acelerando su arco de enemigos a amantes con un stand de una noche que de alguna manera insiste en convertirse en un evento recurrente. Ahora deben ocultar su nave de situación del resto del partido mientras niegan su creciente atracción entre sí, mientras tratan con un imp que está demasiado invertido en su vida amorosa. (Fuente: HIDIVE)

airing.title: Renegade Immortal
airing.description: It tells the story of Wang Lin, an ordinary young man in the countryside, who is moved by his heart and cultivates against immortality. His pursuit is not only for longevity, but also for getting rid of the ants behind it. He firmly believed in human beings and entered the path of cultivation with mediocre qualifications. After experiencing ups and downs, with his wise mind, he gradually reached the pinnacle and became famous in the cultivation world with his own strength. (Source: WeTV)
airing.description_es: Cuenta la historia de Wang Lin, un joven común en el campo, que se mueve por su corazón y cultiva contra la inmortalidad. Su búsqueda no es sólo para la longevidad, sino también para deshacerse de las hormigas detrás de ella. Creyó firmemente en los seres humanos y entró en el camino del cultivo con calificaciones mediocres. Después de experimentar altibajos, con su mente sabia, gradualmente llegó al pináculo y se hizo famoso en el mundo de cultivo con su propia fuerza. (Fuente: WeTV)

airing.description: “Make me a love potion.” And with that single sentence, the Good Witch of the Lake’s secret crush on the dashing Sir Harij ends in heartbreak. Still, when he promises to help her gather the ingredients, Rose is thrilled at the chance to gaze upon a man she’d normally never get to interact with. She learns to brace her pounding heart for their usual stilted conversations…but what is she to do when he inexplicably shows up at her doorstep with bread and a jar of apple butter? (Source: Yen Press)

Sin embargo, cuando promete ayudarla a reunir los ingredientes, Rose está emocionada por la oportunidad de mirar a un hombre con el que normalmente nunca podría interactuar. airing.title: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin?
airing.description: Office worker Akira Yagami’s altruistic nature usually gets him the short end of the stick. When he dies after saving a kid from oncoming traffic...he reincarnates in another world as a goblin?! Normally, goblins only live for seven days, but Akira’s newfound powers let him defy the species’ normal life span...and are the key to his path to becoming the strongest goblin ever! (Source: Yen Press) Note: Tensei Goblin Dakedo Shitsumon Aru? is streaming 1 week in advance of the TV broadcast on ABEMA and Prime Video beginning with episode 2 on October 5th, 2026
airing.description_es: La naturaleza altruista del trabajador de oficina Akira Yagami generalmente le consigue el extremo corto del palo. Cuando muere después de salvar a un niño del tráfico entrante... ¿reencarna en otro mundo como un duende? Normalmente, los duendes sólo viven durante siete días, pero los nuevos poderes de Akira le permiten desafiar el período de vida normal de la especie... ¡y son la clave de su camino para convertirse en el más fuerte de todos los tiempos! (Fuente: Yen Press) Nota: Tensei Goblin Dakedo Sitsumon Aru?

airing.title: MAGICAL GIRL RAISING PROJECT restart
airing.description: Some magical girls fight. Others do not. Chosen by the mysterious Land of Magic, which exists unbeknownst to the rest of the world, magical girls are each granted a unique power. Pechka, whose magic makes food delicious, is forced to take part in a mysterious virtual game together with 16 unfamiliar magical girls, each with her own distinctive personality. It was supposed to be a safe training exercise designed to improve their magical abilities. But instead, it marks the beginning of a carefully orchestrated nightmare - a forbidden trial. A new Magical Girl Raising Project has begun. (Source: OceanVeil)
airing.description_es: Algunas chicas mágicas pelean. Otros no. Elegido por la misteriosa Tierra de la Magia, que existe poco conocida por el resto del mundo, las chicas mágicas cada una tienen un poder único. Pechka, cuya magia hace deliciosa la comida, se ve obligada a participar en un misterioso juego virtual junto con 16 chicas mágicas desconocidas, cada una con su propia personalidad distintiva. Se suponía que era un ejercicio de entrenamiento seguro diseñado para mejorar sus habilidades mágicas. airing.title: Jueshi Zhan Hun 2
airing.description: In the Canglan Continent, strength is determined by martial spirits. Qin Nan, the young master of the Qin family, was originally a useless soul, suffering endless scorn. By chance, he awakened the soul of an ancient war god, thus defying fate. He swept through sect geniuses, overcame powerful enemies and obstacles, encountered a soulmate, used his battle spirit to break all laws, and forged a legend with his blood. From a humble young master, he rose through the ranks to become an invincible supreme celestial being who shakes the nine realms. (Source: IQIYI, translated)
airing.description_es: En el Continente Canglan, la fuerza está determinada por espíritus marciales. Qin Nan, el joven maestro de la familia Qin, fue originalmente un alma inútil, sufriendo un desprecio infinito. Por casualidad, despertó el alma de un dios de guerra antiguo, desafiando así el destino. Golpeó por los genios de la secta, superó a los poderosos enemigos y obstáculos, encontró a un alma gemela, usó su espíritu de batalla para romper todas las leyes, y forjó una leyenda con su sangre. De un humilde joven maestro, se levantó por las filas para convertirse en un ser celestial supremo invencible que sacude los nueve reinos. (Fuente: IQIYI, traducido)

airing.title: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden
airing.description: A great hero lies undefeated on her deathbed, regretting that she never found a foe who could take her down. She never intended to meet her fate anywhere other than on the battlefield, and her peaceful demise has her wishing desperately that things could have been different... But when she suddenly comes to in the body of the young, frail Nia Liston, she’s got an all-new fight ahead of her. Nia is a sickly child, meaning she has a long way to go before she’s in fighting form. Now that she’s been given a second shot at life, however, she’s determined to get what she wants. She’s going to live—and die—for battle this time! Make way for the Merciless Maiden! (Source: J-Novel Club)
airing.description_es: Un gran héroe está invicto en su lecho de muerte, lamentando que nunca haya encontrado a un enemigo que pudiera derribarla. Nunca quiso encontrar su destino en otro lugar que en el campo de batalla, y su pacífica desaparición tiene su deseo desesperadamente de que las cosas podrían haber sido diferentes... Pero cuando de repente viene al cuerpo de la joven y frágil Nia Liston, tiene una nueva lucha por delante de ella. Nia es una niña enferma, lo que significa que tiene un largo camino por recorrer

airing.title: The Cold Sato-san is Only Sweet to Me
airing.description: Sato-san is the unattainable flower of the class. She is always cold and curt with classmates, but only I know she's actually very cute when she smiles, even if she's not much of a photographer. Oshio-kun is friendly and lively, but only I know he works at his family's cafe after school. He does a great job with the cafe's SNS account, and his mischievous smile makes my heart skip a beat! Innocent and sweet, but sometimes frustrating, this is a 120%-pure fluffy story about two people falling in love for the first time.

airing.title: Super Psychic Policeman Chojo
airing.description: The ultimate police duo is here to keep the peace! Rookie officer Nao just joined the force. She’s got a black belt in judo and earned the nickname “Gorilla” for her insane strength. Then there’s her partner Chojo, who wields every psychic power imaginable. But for a guy who can read minds, he still can’t seem to read the room. Now, these two are taking on crime together in Chinjuku. (Source: Crunchyroll)
airing.description_es: ¡El último dúo policial está aquí para mantener la paz! El oficial novato Nao acaba de unirse a la fuerza. Tiene un cinturón negro en judo y ganó el apodo "Gorilla" por su fuerza loca. Luego está su compañero Chojo, quien controla todo poder psíquico imaginable. Pero para un tipo que puede leer mentes, todavía no puede leer la habitación. Estos dos están cometiendo un crimen juntos en Chinjuku. (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

airing.title: Battle Spirits [Re] Zekkai No Ku
airing.description: Keio 3, Hinomoto, Eito. As the Bakumatsu throws Japan into turmoil, young Kuu Bashin dreams of becoming stronger through Standard Battle Spirits. His world changes when he encounters Ajara Zetsu, a wandering samurai and formidable Eternal Battler pursued by anti-shogunate forces. As the worlds of Standard and Eternal Battle collide, Kuu is pulled into Zetsu’s journey—and sets history in motion. (Source: Crunchyroll)
airing.description_es: Keio 3, Hinomoto, Eito. A medida que el Bakumatsu lanza a Japón en agitación, el joven Kuu Bashin sueña con volverse más fuerte a través de los Espíritus de Batalla Estándar. Su mundo cambia cuando se encuentra con Ajara Zetsu, un samurai errante y formidable Batalla Eterna perseguido por fuerzas antihogunadas. Mientras los mundos de la batalla estándar y eterna chocan, Kuu es llevado al viaje de Zetsu, y pone la historia en movimiento. (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

airing.title: Gensou Suikoden
airing.description: Two young boys... the hero, Riliu, and his best friend Jowy, were members of a youth brigade of their home nation, the Highland Kingdom - a powerful military nation located in the north-east of the Dunan region. The two of them looked up at the same starry skies, slept in the same tent, and believed in the same future. Once the fighting was over, and the night ended, their daily lives were sure to return. Contrary to their hopes, the two boys become swept up in the whirlpool of fate, guided by the flames of war. The powerless boys reached for, and grasped immense power. As the 108 stars shine brightly in the murky horizon, the boys step forward, each with their own beliefs for an answer-less question. (Source: Official Website, translated) Note: The first episode aired with a runtime of ~50 minutes as opposed to the standard 24 minute long episode.
airing.description_es: Dos jóvenes... el héroe, Riliu, y su mejor amigo Jowy, eran miembros de una brigada juvenil de su nación natal, el Reino de Highland, una poderosa nación militar situada en el noreste de la región de Dunan. Los dos miraron hacia arriba los mismos cielos estrellados, durmieron en la misma tienda, y creyeron en el mismo futuro. Una vez que la pelea terminó, y la noche terminó, sus vidas diarias estaban seguras de volver. Contrariamente a sus esperanzas, los dos chicos se arrastran en el torbellino del destino, guiados por las llamas de la guerra. Los chicos impotentes alcanzaron y captaron un inmenso poder. Como brillan las 108 estrellas

airing.title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
airing.description: Rein, an enchanter, is suddenly expelled from his guild one day. But instead of despairing, he declares, “Now I can do anything!” and begins reclaiming the massive number of enhancement points he once poured into his guildmates’ gear, setting off on a brand-new path as an adventurer. Gathering around him are people carrying wounds that don’t fade easily: a genius adventurer who shut her heart after her party was slaughtered, a warrior who lost her family, and an assassin raised from childhood to kill. Yet Rein never rejects their pasts or their scars—he accepts them all with bright, straightforward warmth. The stage is a unique fantasy world where Uzis, slingshots, and even yakuza exist side by side. But in this world, the more people rely on convenient technology, the more their magic weakens, and adventurers grow fragile. Intelligent, vicious monsters roam freely, while in the underworld, outlaws bare their greed and ambition as schemes and betrayals intertwine. In a world where ideals and justice are easily crushed, adventurers fight on with nothing but their magic and their convictions. This is the story of those who have lost their place in the world finding a new way to live. Rein and his companions’ wild, free-spirited second life begins now! (Source: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life Site)
airing.description_es: Rein, un encantador, es expulsado de su gremio un día. Pero en lugar de desesperar, declara, “¡Ahora puedo hacer cualquier cosa!” y comienza a reclamar el enorme número de puntos de mejora que una vez vierte en el equipo de sus compañeros, a partir de un nuevo camino como aventurero. Reunirse a su alrededor son personas que llevan heridas que no se desvanecen fácilmente: un genio aventurero que cerró su corazón después de que su partido fue masacrado, un guerrero que perdió

airing.title: Red River
airing.description: After a mysterious hand drags her beneath a puddle, modern Japanese teenager Yuri awakens in the Hittite Empire of the 14th century BCE. Thrust into a deadly struggle for the throne, she joins Prince Kail to battle assassins, outwit royal conspiracies, and survive a world at war. As her exploits earn her renown as the goddess Ishtar, Yuri must choose between her old life and an uncertain future. (Source: Crunchyroll)
airing.description_es: Después de una mano misteriosa la arrastra debajo de un charco, moderno adolescente japonés Yuri despierta en el imperio hitita del siglo 14 AC. Entró en una lucha mortal por el trono, se une al Príncipe Kail para combatir a asesinos, superar conspiraciones reales y sobrevivir a un mundo en guerra. Mientras sus hazañas ganan su renombre como la diosa Ishtar, Yuri debe elegir entre su vida vieja y un futuro incierto. (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

airing.title: DARK MACHINE THE ANIMATION
airing.description: Following his grandfather’s will to “seek out the Senki,” the protagonist Kairi visits Golden Valley, a special Dark Machine economic zone. There, he meets a mysterious girl named Rudra. Dragged into becoming a Dark Machine player by Rudra, Kairi’s talent gradually blossoms over the course of many intense battles. (Source: Fuji Creative) Note: Part of the "DARK MACHINE" Web3 cross-media project where the story of the Game and its anime adaptation intertwine.
airing.description_es: Siguiendo la voluntad de su abuelo de “buscar el Senki”, el protagonista Kairi visita Golden Valley, una zona económica especial de la máquina oscura. Allí, conoce a una chica misteriosa llamada Rudra. Se convirtió en un jugador de la máquina oscura por Rudra, el talento de Kairi florece gradualmente en el curso de muchas batallas intensas. (Fuente: Fuji Creative) Nota: Parte del proyecto "DARK MACHINE" Web3 cross-media donde se entrelazan la historia del juego y su adaptación de anime.

airing.title: mofusand
airing.description: Shark Meow is an orange tabby kitty who wears a shark suit. A little clumsy and always taking things at their own cozy pace, but every day with their best kitty friends — and the rescued baby kitty, Little Meow — is filled with unexpected little mishaps and sweet adventures. A sunny warm spot in the park, the sparkle of the sea, steam rising from freshly roasted sweet potatoes, the fluttery feeling of the first snowfall… These small everyday moments fill their world with warmth and delight. You can’t help but smile and think, “So true!” A soft and snuggly kitty anime that brings joy to everyday moments. (Source: QTORY Channel)
airing.description_es: Shark Meow es un gatito de tabby naranja que lleva un traje de tiburón. Un poco torpe y siempre tomando cosas a su propio ritmo acogedor, pero todos los días con sus mejores amigos gatitos — y el gatito salvada, Little Meow— está lleno de pequeños revuelos inesperados y aventuras dulces. Un lugar cálido soleado en el parque, la chispa del mar, el vapor subiendo de las batatas recién asadas, la sensación de la primera nevada... airing.description: After battling in Kyoto and Nerima, the Rasetsu Academy students have grown stronger. But Yaoroshi leaves the academy to join the Oni Brigade for their "the total eradication of the Momotaro." When Shiki realizes that they also target noncombatants, he sets out after Yaoroshi to bring him back. Meanwhile in Nikko, there's a research facility for horrific experiments atop the old Kegon Falls… (Source: REMOW)
airing.description_es: Después de luchar en Kioto y Nerima, los estudiantes de la Academia Rasetsu se han hecho más fuertes. Pero Yaoroshi deja la academia para unirse a la Brigada Oni por su "erración total del Momotaro". Cuando Shiki se da cuenta de que también apuntan a los no combatientes, se pone después de Yaoroshi para traerlo de vuelta. Mientras tanto, en Nikko, hay una instalación de investigación para experimentos horribles en la antigua Kegon Falls... (Fuente: REMOW)

airing.title: Please Excuse My Younger Brothers
airing.description: The manga centers on high school student Ito Hazui. During her spring break at the end of her first year of high school, Ito's mother remarries, and Ito moves to live with her new family, becoming Ito Narita. Upon arriving at her new house, Ito is shocked to learn she now has four younger step-brothers. Ito tries her hardest to get along with all of the new members of her family, but the eldest brother Gen is a bit cold to her. However, under his aloof facade, he occasionally shows his kindness. (Source: Anime News Network)
airing.description_es: El manga se centra en el estudiante de secundaria Ito Hazui. Durante su descanso de primavera al final de su primer año de secundaria, la madre de Ito se vuelve a casar, y Ito se mueve a vivir con su nueva familia, convirtiéndose en Ito Narita. Al llegar a su nueva casa, Ito está sorprendido de saber que ahora tiene cuatro hermanos menores. Ito trata de que ella sea más difícil de llevar con todos los nuevos miembros de su familia, pero el hermano mayor Gen es un poco frío para ella. Sin embargo, bajo su fachada, ocasionalmente muestra su amabilidad. (Fuente: Anime News Network)

airing.title: RILAKKUMA
airing.description: Everyday life gets a cozy twist with the laid-back Rilakkuma. Gentle moments of friendship, change, and small joys unfold, turning ordinary moments into something quietly magical—one soft, comforting day at a time. It's a moment that will make your heart feel lighter and lighter. No matter where you are or what you're doing, Rilakkuma will be by your side. An exciting new story begins! Experience the stress-free world of Rilakkuma, the relaxed bear who makes being lazy look effortless! (Source: Crunchyroll, Rilakkuma Anime Site, translated)
airing.description_es: Cada día la vida recibe un toque acogedor con el relajado Rilakkuma. Los momentos suaves de amistad, cambio y las pequeñas alegrías se desarrollan, convirtiendo los momentos ordinarios en algo silenciosamente mágico — un día suave y reconfortante a la vez. Es un momento que hará que su corazón se sienta más ligero y más ligero. No importa dónde estés o lo que estés haciendo, Rilakkuma estará a tu lado. ¡Una nueva historia emocionante comienza! ¡Experimente el mundo libre de estrés de Rilakkuma, el oso relajado que hace ser perezoso sin esfuerzo! (Fuente: Crunchyroll, Rilakkuma Anime Site, traducido)

airing.description: Sergeant Keroro comes to conquer Earth, only to get captured and stuck living with the Hinata family! (Source: Crunchyroll)
airing.description_es: ¡El sargento Keroro viene a conquistar la Tierra, sólo para ser capturado y atrapado viviendo con la familia Hinata! (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

airing.title: A Good Day to Ascend
airing.description: In the chaotic times, demons and monsters roam freely, and treacherous officials are in power. With the invasion of the Netherworld, both humans and Netherworld beings wreak havoc on the mortal world, and the wild gods who work for the Netherworld bully the common people. Enraged, Xu Ying, a snake-catcher, rebels and commits the sin of killing a god, and also takes out an incompetent court official. Hunted down by the two realms, his fleeing begins... (Source: iQ)
airing.description_es: En los tiempos caóticos, demonios y monstruos andan libremente, y funcionarios traicioneros están en el poder. Con la invasión del Netherworld, los seres humanos y el Netherworld causaron estragos en el mundo mortal, y los dioses salvajes que trabajan para el Netherworld intimidan al pueblo común. Enfurecido, Xu Ying, un cazador de serpientes, rebelde y comete el pecado de matar a un dios, y también saca a un funcionario de la corte incompetente. Cazado por los dos reinos, su huida comienza... (Fuente: iQ)

airing.title: Soul Land 2: The Peerless Tang Clan
airing.description: The Tang Sect in a turbulent world. There is nothing but martial spirit here. Ten thousand years after the founding of the Tang Sect, it is in relative decline. An extremely talented man was born. Can the new Shrek Seven Monsters revive the Tang Sect and bring it back to glory? A soul beast of over one million years old; Electrolux who can pick stars; The new soul utensil system that led to the decline of the Tang Sect... A lot of secrets are to be revealed. Can the secret weapons of the Tang Sect be sharp again? Can the Tang Sect regain its former glory? (Source: WeTV)
airing.description_es: El Tang Sect en un mundo turbulento. Aquí no hay nada más que espíritu marcial. Diez mil años después de la fundación del Tang Sect, está en declive relativo. Nació un hombre extremadamente talentoso. ¿Pueden los nuevos Monstruos Shrek revivir el Tang Sect y traerlo de vuelta a la gloria? Una bestia de alma de más de un millón de años; Electrolux que puede elegir estrellas; El nuevo sistema de utensilios de alma que llevó al declive del Tang Sect... Hay que revelar muchos secretos. ¿Pueden volver a afilarse las armas secretas del Tang Sect? ¿Puede el Tang Sect recuperar su antigua gloria? (Fuente: WeTV)

airing.title: Shin Chan
airing.description: Crayon Shin-chan follows the wacky antics and adventures of five-year-old Shinnosuke "Shin" Nohara and his parents, neighbors, and friends and is set in Kasukabe, Saitama Prefecture, Japan. Many of the jokes in the series stem from Shin-chan's occasionally weird, unnatural and inappropriate use of language, as well as from his inappropriate behavior. A typical gag involves Shin-chan confounding his parents by using the wrong phrase for the occasion; for example, saying "Welcome back!" instead of "I am back!" when he comes home. During the beginning of the series, the TV show was mostly based on the storyline in the original manga. As the show progressed, more and more episodes became anime-original.
airing.description_es: Crayon Shin-chan sigue los locos anticos y aventuras de Shinnosuke, de cinco años, "Shin" Nohara y sus padres, vecinos y amigos, y se encuentra en Kasukabe, Prefectura de Saitama, Japón. Muchas de las bromas de la serie provienen del uso extraño, antinatural e inapropiado del lenguaje de Shin-chan, así como de su comportamiento inapropiado. Una mordaza típica involucra a Shin-chan confundiendo a sus padres usando la frase equivocada para la ocasión; por ejemplo, diciendo "¡Bienvenido!" en lugar de "Estoy de vuelta!" cuando él vuelve. airing.description_es: Una nueva serie Doraemon producida por el mismo equipo que la serie 1979 (en asociación con Studio Pierrot) con nuevos actores de voz y personal y diseños de caracteres actualizados.

airing.title: The Vermilion Mask
airing.description: "The Mask” gives power to anyone who wears it. At times, that means endless possibility, or unimaginable tragedy… Peru, pupil of the legendary mask maker Gaston Roux, becomes controlled by the “Mask of the Warrior God,” and unintentionally kills his friends, and even his own master. In order to prevent this type of tragedy from reoccurring, Peru swears to destroy all of Gaston’s masks that are spread around the world. Confronting the sins that he has committed, he embarks on his voyage. Meeting new friends, then confronting powerful foes. The boy continues on. Until the day he can atone for his sins against his master. (Source: The Vermillion Mask English Site)
airing.description_es: "La máscara" da poder a cualquiera que la use. A veces, eso significa una posibilidad interminable, o una tragedia inimaginable... Perú, alumno del legendario fabricante de máscaras Gaston Roux, se hace controlado por el “Mask del Dios Guerrero”, y mata involuntariamente a sus amigos, e incluso a su propio maestro. Para evitar que este tipo de tragedia vuelva a ocurrir, Perú jura destruir todas las máscaras de Gaston que se extienden alrededor del mundo. Frente a los pecados que ha cometido, se embarca en su viaje. Conocer a nuevos amigos y enfrentar a poderosos enemigos. El chico continúa. Hasta el día que puede expiar por hola

airing.title: Detective Conan
airing.description: Kudo Shinichi is a seventeen year-old high school detective whom people call the "Modern Sherlock Holmes." However, one night after a date with his childhood sweetheart, Ran, Shinichi witnessed an illegal trade and, caught off his guard, was knocked unconscious and fed a drug that was supposed to kill him... but he woke up and found himself shrunken to a seven year-old. In order to track down the men who did this to him, Shinichi hid his identity and lived with Ran, whose father happened to be a hopeless detective, and with that came a series of murders and mysteries that he must solve. (Source: Anime News Network) Note: - Includes Keisatsu Gakkou-hen - Wild Police Story in episodes 1029, 1038, 1042, 1061 - Episodes 11, 52, 76, 118, 162, 184, 208, 342, 356, 449, 452, 487, 488, 489, 490, 515, 516, 521, 522, 651, 734, 804, 805, 927, 928, 1187 aired with a runtime of ~50 minutes as opposed to the standard 25 minute long episode. - Episodes 96, 129, 174, 219, 263, 304, 383, 479 aired with a runtime of ~90 minutes as opposed to the standard 25 minute long episode. - Episode 345, 425 aired with a runtime of ~115 minutes as opposed to the standard 25 minute long episode.
airing.description_es: Kudo Shinichi es un detective de secundaria de diecisiete años a quien la gente llama "Modern Sherlock Holmes". Sin embargo, una noche después de una cita con su novia de la infancia, Ran, Shinichi fue testigo de un comercio ilegal y, atrapado de su guardia, fue noqueado inconsciente y alimentado una droga que se suponía que lo mataría... pero se despertó y se encontró a sí mismo hundido a un niño de siete años. Para localizar a los hombres que le hicieron esto, Shinichi escondió su identidad y vivió con Ran, cuyo padre fue un detective sin esperanza, y con eso llegó una serie de asesinatos y misterios que él debe resolver. (Sourc)

airing.title: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom
airing.description: At the heart of a continent of eight kingdoms lies the Marronnier Kingdom. Its general, Baribara, has seven sons, each with a unique gift and serving as a knight commander. Bound by a single noble cause of heroically rescuing a princess someday, the brothers set out as goodwill ambassadors to the seven neighboring kingdoms. What encounters, trials, and destinies await them in these unknown lands? (Source: Amazon Prime Video)
airing.description_es: En el corazón de un continente de ocho reinos se encuentra el Reino Marronnier. Su general, Baribara, tiene siete hijos, cada uno con un regalo único y servir como comandante caballero. Heridos por una única causa noble de rescatar heroicamente a una princesa algún día, los hermanos se establecieron como embajadores de buena voluntad a los siete reinos vecinos. ¿Qué encuentros, pruebas y destinos les esperan en estas tierras desconocidas? (Fuente: Amazon Prime Video)

airing.description: Romelia and her party succeed in defeating the Demon King Zelgis, though Prince Henri’s reckless charge forces them into a grueling battle. In the aftermath, Romelia is branded "dead weight" for not fighting directly, and the Prince unilaterally breaks off their engagement. Denied a place in the victory celebrations, Romelia returns home, only to be met with cold indifference from her family and society. Yet, she refuses to break. She has already set her sights on the path that lies ahead. (Source: Crunchyroll) Note: Romelia War Chronicle was streamed 2 days in advance of the TV broadcast on AnimeTimes, U-NEXT, and Netflix beginning October 3, 2026. Regular broadcasting began on October 5, 2026.
airing.description_es: Romelia y su partido tienen éxito en derrotar al Rey demonio Zelgis, aunque la carga imprudente del príncipe Henri los obliga a una batalla agotadora. Después, Romelia se marca "peso muerto" por no luchar directamente, y el Príncipe unilateralmente rompe su compromiso. Denegado un lugar en las celebraciones de la victoria, Romelia vuelve a casa, sólo para ser conocido con indiferencia fría de su familia y sociedad. Sin embargo, se niega a romper. Ella ya ha puesto sus ojos en el camino que está por delante. (Fuente: Crunchyroll) Nota: Romelia War Chronicle fue transmitido 2 días antes de la emisión de televisión en A

airing.title: A Tale of the Secret Saint
airing.description: Fia always dreamed of becoming a knight. Born into a family of knights, she’s the least talented among them, but she still clutches to her hope and trains with everything she has. When the day comes for her to slay a small demon and prove her worth, she ends up face to face with a dragon instead! A deadly injury makes her life flash before her eyes…and she suddenly remembers her former life, when she was a powerful Saint in a bygone era who defeated the Demon King. That life ended in pain because of who she was, making her fear ever becoming a Saint again. Now that the magic from her previous life has been rekindled, she may become a more powerful knight than she ever dreamed–if only she can survive long enough! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: The series streamed a week in advance on ABEMA, Prime Video, and Crunchyroll starting with episode 2 released alongside episode 1.
airing.description_es: Fia siempre soñó con convertirse en un caballero. Nacida en una familia de caballeros, es la menos talentosa entre ellos, pero todavía se aferra a su esperanza y trenes con todo lo que tiene. Cuando llega el día para que mate a un pequeño demonio y pruebe su valor, termina cara a cara con un dragón en su lugar! Una herida mortal hace que su vida parpadee ante sus ojos... y de repente recuerda su vida anterior, cuando era un poderoso santo en una era pasada que venció al Rey demonio. airing.title: Black Clover Season 2
airing.description: As tyranny engulfs the Clover Kingdom, Asta and the Magic Knights launch a desperate raid on the Spade Kingdom to rescue their squad captains from the Dark Triad. But their mission leads them into a brutal battle against forces beyond anything they’ve ever faced. Now, Asta must rise above impossible odds to protect his friends and honor the promise he made to Yuno. (Source: Crunchyroll)
airing.description_es: A medida que la tiranía envuelve el Reino de Clover, Asta y los Caballeros Mágicos lanzan una redada desesperada en el Reino de Spade para rescatar a sus capitanes de la Tribu Oscura. Pero su misión los lleva a una batalla brutal contra las fuerzas más allá de cualquier cosa que hayan enfrentado. Ahora, Asta debe elevarse por encima de las probabilidades imposibles de proteger a sus amigos y honrar la promesa que hizo a Yuno. (Fuente: Crunchyroll)
