airing.title: VERTEX FORCE
airing.description: Akira lives a peaceful life with his older sister Haruka and his mother, who runs a cafe. The family however harbors a secret — Haruka has inherited a power from her father called "Engine," and she hides that power from others. Akira on the other hand has not inherited his father's power, and he has an inferiority complex about it. Amidst this, strange events start happening around the world. (Source: Anime News Network)
airing.description_es: Akira vive una vida pacífica con su hermana mayor Haruka y su madre, que dirige un café. Sin embargo, la familia alberga un secreto — Haruka ha heredado un poder de su padre llamado "Engine", y esconde ese poder de otros. Akira, por otro lado, no ha heredado el poder de su padre, y tiene un complejo de inferioridad. En medio de esto, acontecimientos extraños comienzan a suceder alrededor del mundo. (Fuente: Anime News Network)

airing.title: #I'm Looking For a Zombie
airing.description: It may be a ruined city ravaged by zombies, but to Aki and her friends, it’s amazing! Having grown up only hearing stories of the old world and the mysterious outbreak that wiped out humanity, she sets off with her childhood friends in search of her missing father. Things quickly become a fight for survival outside the safety of their small village, yet they’ve never felt more alive. (Source: Crunchyroll)
airing.description_es: Puede ser una ciudad arruinada devastada por zombis, pero para Aki y sus amigos, ¡es increíble! Habiendo crecido sólo escuchando historias del viejo mundo y el misterioso brote que borró a la humanidad, se pone con sus amigos de la infancia en busca de su padre desaparecido. Las cosas se convierten rápidamente en una lucha por la supervivencia fuera de la seguridad de su pequeño pueblo, sin embargo nunca se han sentido más vivos. (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

airing.title: HORROR COLLECTOR
airing.description: Urban legends come to life…Everyone’s heard an urban legend before, but few have ever come face-to-face with one. These phenomena are everywhere, existing in the shadows of reality. More and more of them have been appearing in the wake of the faceless kid sighted all over Japan. If you see her or one of the urban legends she brings―pray the boy in the red hood finds you before it’s too late. You won’t stand a chance on your own. But with his help, you may just live to see another day… (Source: Yen Press)
airing.description_es: Las leyendas urbanas cobran vida... Todos han oído una leyenda urbana antes, pero pocos han llegado cara a cara con uno. Estos fenómenos están en todas partes, existentes en las sombras de la realidad. Cada vez más de ellos han estado apareciendo a raíz del niño sin rostro visto por todo Japón. Si la ves o una de las leyendas urbanas que trae, ora al chico en la capucha roja te encuentra antes de que sea demasiado tarde. Usted no tendrá una oportunidad por su cuenta. Pero con su ayuda, puedes vivir para ver otro día... (Fuente: Yen Press)

airing.title: Magical Explorer
airing.description: Few titles are more revered among horndogs-(ahem) connoisseurs of Japanese erotic video games-than Magical Explorer. One day, our smut-loving hero wakes up to find he has been reincarnated into the body of the game’s dreamboat protagonist! Or rather, his hapless comic-relief best friend, Kousuke Takioto. But with his unparalleled knowledge of Magical Explorer and Kousuke’s unorthodox abilities (a scarf that doubles as a fist?), our hero vows to turn the game’s unluckiest loser into its mightiest heartthrob. In this world, nothing is out of reach when you’ve got the know-how! (Source: Yen Press) Note: Each episode streamed 1 week early on ABEMA and d anime store. The original TV broadcast started on October 4th, 2026.
airing.description_es: Pocos títulos son más venerados entre los erizos-(ahem) conocedores de videojuegos eróticos japoneses-que Magical Explorer. Un día, nuestro héroe amante de la mugre se despierta para encontrar que ha sido reencarnado en el cuerpo del protagonista de la lancha del juego! O más bien, su mejor amigo, Kousuke Takioto. Pero con su inigualable conocimiento de Magical Explorer y las habilidades de Kousuke poco ortodoxas (una bufanda que se dobla como un puño?), nuestro héroe promete convertir el perdedor más desafortunado del juego en su corazón más poderoso. En este mundo, nada está fuera de alcance cuando tienes el know-how! (Fuente: Yen Press

airing.title: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
airing.description: This is Fujinasu Academy, a private high school with top-achieving students located on the outskirts of town. High School 1st-Year Ume Mizunoe has excellent grades in Japanese language class and has received multiple literary awards. However, his terrible grades in the sciences are affecting his ability to move up a grade. To avoid repeating a year, he becomes a member of the student council to improve his academic standing. However, in the student council, he meets the charismatic yet sullen student council president Kotobuki Hisako, and the scary yet kind and refined treasurer, Arisu Terui. Other members include a cheeky and cute boy, Tan Otori, and Komaro Michinoku, the admin who's like a small abandoned cat. This is the start of a slapstick, heartful, rom-com about a busy student council full of cute, mismatched, and quirky students! (Source: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! Official Site)

High School 1er año Ume Mizunoe tiene excelentes calificaciones en la clase de idioma japonés y ha recibido múltiples premios literarios. Sin embargo, sus calificaciones terribles en las ciencias están afectando su capacidad de avanzar en un grado. airing.title: Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I’ll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest!
airing.description: If there's one thing you can never have enough of in a world of RPG-style swords and sorcery, it's magic points! Whether you're fueling spells, techniques, or showing off an incredible ability, you've gotta spend those points to do real damage. But what if you run out? Lent is part of the up-and-coming party known as the “Skypiercers,” and thanks to his unique Gift, he can loan massive amounts of magic to others. No MP? No problem with Lent around! Except, now that his companions have become formidable heroes (thanks to his skill), his usefulness is questioned. Kicked out of the group, Lent is furious…until he discovers a hidden power to his Gift. Now, with his adorably devious fairy partner, he's going to claw back every last scrap of magic from his former party—with interest! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Si estás alimentando hechizos, técnicas o mostrando una habilidad increíble, tienes que gastar esos puntos para hacer daño real. ¿Y si te escapas? La Cuaresma es parte de la fiesta de llegada conocida como los "Skypiercers", y gracias a su regalo único, puede prestar enormes cantidades de magia a otros. ¿Sin MP? ¡No hay problema con la Cuaresma! airing.title: Yuruyuru Zukan
airing.description: Gakken's hugely popular illustrated encyclopedia series, which everyone can enjoy with its laid-back four-panel comics, is finally being adapted into a TV anime! Discover surprising aspects and fun facts about living creatures—full of secrets that will make you say, "Wow!" Enjoy this new kind of anime that makes even scary things fun and easy to watch, with its cute art style. (Source: Official Site, translated)
airing.description_es: La popular y popular serie de enciclopedias ilustradas de Gakken, que todos pueden disfrutar con sus cómics de cuatro paneles, finalmente se está adaptando a un anime de televisión! Descubre aspectos sorprendentes y hechos divertidos sobre los seres vivientes, llenos de secretos que te harán decir: "¡Wow!" Disfruta de este nuevo tipo de anime que hace que las cosas aterradoras sean divertidas y fáciles de ver, con su estilo de arte lindo. (Fuente: Sitio oficial, traducido)

airing.title: Raccoon Dog & Fox
airing.description: The story centers on the daily lives of a raccoon dog who is not quite with it and a mischievous fox who likes to tease the raccoon dog. The two are close friends who live together on a mountain. Their other friends include a wolf, a bear, a rabbit, and birds. (Source: Anime News Network)
airing.description_es: La historia se centra en la vida diaria de un perro de mapache que no está bien con él y un zorro malicioso que le gusta burlar al perro de mapache. Los dos son amigos cercanos que viven juntos en una montaña. Sus otros amigos incluyen un lobo, un oso, un conejo y aves. (Fuente: Anime News Network)

airing.title: Koupen-chan
airing.description: The story of the series follows the everyday adventures of Koupen-chan and his friends as they enjoy the little things in life. (Source: Crunchyroll News, edited)
airing.description_es: La historia de la serie sigue las aventuras cotidianas de Koupen-chan y sus amigos mientras disfrutan de las pequeñas cosas en la vida. (Fuente: Crunchyroll News, editado)

airing.title: Star Detective Precure!
airing.description: Anna Akechi is a second-year junior high student living in Makoto Mirai Town. On her 14th birthday, she has a chance encounter with a fairy named Pochitan, and a magical pendant caused her to travel back in time from 2027 to 1999! In the Makoto Mirai Town 28 years in the past, Anna meets Mikuru Kobayashi, a girl her age who wants to become a great detective. Meanwhile, people in town are in trouble as their prized possessions are being stolen from under their noses - the cause being a group of Phantom Thieves. To stop them, Anna and Mikuru turn into Precures! Maybe if they solve these mysteries, Anna can find her way back to her own time? (Source: Official Website, translated)

airing.title: Sazae-san
airing.description: The main character is a mother named Sazae-san. She lives in a house with her husband, her kid, her siblings and her parents. The show is the ultimate family program and tends to follow traditional themes. Think of this show as the Japanese equivalent to "The Partridge Family" and you'll get a good feel for this show's atmosphere. Don't expect to see things like violence, swearing, kung-fu action or magical girls. The plots are more like "Today, Sazae-san goes to the new mall and gets lost". Such "boring" plotlines and the simplistic art are often a turn-off to non-Japanese audiences, but most Japanese find the show incredibly good. As a result, it continues to be one of the top ratings grabbers on TV and is one of the few anime that is considered "acceptable" by adults.
airing.description_es: El personaje principal es una madre llamada Sazae-san. Vive en una casa con su marido, su hijo, sus hermanos y sus padres. airing.description: Sato Takahiro was an ordinary office worker and hobbyist gamer until the day he woke up on a spaceship–one that strangely resembled a craft from a favorite space-shooter game. With a decked-out ship, a crew full of babes, and a fantastic universe to explore, he's going to make the most of his good luck and create the life he's always dreamed of! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Con un barco desguace, una tripulación llena de chicas, y un universo fantástico para explorar, él va a aprovechar al máximo su buena suerte y crear la vida que siempre ha soñado con! By night, he dotes on his favorite mascot, Pugtaro, and indulges his secret obsession with all things cute! Rather, it's her brother, Nagi, a strong assassin who took a bullet to protect his sister, leaving him in a comatose state and having to use a wheelchair. However, Shizuka has figured out the key to waking her brother up: he must be faced with killing intent! Thus begins a violent journey of recovery, battling the most dangerous foes! Sin embargo, Shizuka ha descubierto la clave para despertar a su hermano: ¡debe enfrentarse con la intención de matar! Even Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus's overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku. Targeted by Beerus, the strongest being in the universe, Earth is in grave danger. Thus begins an earth-shattering cosmic battle between the God of Destruction and Goku and his alliesa—a conflict that will shake the entire universe. (Source: Official Site) Note: “Enhanced” edition of Dragon Ball Super, featuring a large volume of newly added and redrawn cuts, a reconstructed narrative, and updated visuals for a more immersive and faithful representation of Akira Toriyama’s original manga.

Panicked, he asks his childhood friend Mone, sitting next to him, to take a look, only to be brushed off... Once Takumi realizes he could actually control it himself, he uses the mouse cursor— visible only to him— to slip it in between Mone's clothes and starts clicking away... As they grow closer, Koyuki and Minato begin to develop feelings for each other that go beyond mere friendship. Meanwhile, Youta finally confesses to Miki the feelings he's harbored for years. Some speak their hearts while others keep their emotions hidden, causing their paths — and their feelings for one another — to continuously cross and pass by… (Source: Netflix)
entries.description_es: Koyuki, la chica aislada; Miki, el antiguo ídolo escolar; Minato, el tipo sin concepto de espacio personal; y Youta, el amable jugador de baloncesto. Clumsy, frustrante, pero profundamente apasionante — este drama que se acerca a la edad de los corazones cruzados avanza. A medida que se acercan, Koyuki y Minato comienzan a desarrollar sentimientos entre sí que van más allá de la mera amistad. Mientras tanto, Youta finalmente confiesa a Miki los sentimientos por los que ha albergado

entries.title: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan
entries.description: University student Kurumi Fukuga has finally fulfilled her long-held desire of starting foreign exchange (FX) trading, motivated by recouping the 20 million yen her late mother lost in trading. "I'll easily make it back," she thought, but the world she enters can become heaven or hell in an instant. Unrealized losses, loss-cutting, unstoppable fluctuations… but she still wants to buy, sell and make money! With fellow FX addicts Mochiko, Mebuki and Yasuko along for the ride, the market heats up! Joy, despair, joy, despair — this is an endearing, yet slightly risky money game. Can Kurumi and her friends survive this turbulent world? (Source: Crunchyroll)
entries.description_es: La estudiante universitaria Kurumi Fukuga finalmente ha cumplido su deseo de iniciar el comercio de divisas (FX), motivado por recuperar los 20 millones de yenes que su madre falleció en el comercio. "Lo recuperaré fácilmente," pensó, pero el mundo en el que entra puede convertirse en el cielo o el infierno en un instante. entries.title: The Prince of Tennis II U-17 WORLD CUP: Final Member Selection Match
entries.description: Old rivalries reignite as Team Japan players face off to earn spots in the lineup for the World Cup final. (Source: Crunchyroll News)
entries.description_es: Las viejas rivalidades reinan cuando los jugadores del equipo Japón se enfrentan para ganar puntos en la alineación para la final de la Copa Mundial. (Fuente: Crunchyroll News)

entries.description_es: Cuarta temporada de PetitCure: Ferias precarias.

The Apothecary Diaries Season 3
entries.description: In the aftermath of the Shi Clan’s rebellion, things have finally settled down, and Maomao has returned to her old life as a pharmacist in the pleasure district. One day, triggered by a breakfast served at the Verdigris House, Maomao senses an anomaly and begins investigating its true nature. Meanwhile, Jinshi, who has revealed his true identity as the Imperial brother and begun to face his heavy responsibilities, is deeply troubled by the final message left by Loulan: a warning of an impending "disaster that will strike the nation." To make matters worse, rumors of a mysterious shrine maiden who deceives the people begin to spread, casting a dark shadow over the country of Li once again. From the depths of the inner court to the city streets, and across foreign borders—the world grows wider, and the stakes even higher for Maomao and Jinshi. (Source: Crunchyroll)
entries.description_es: Después de la rebelión del clan Shi, las cosas finalmente se han asentado, y Maomao ha vuelto a su antigua vida como farmacéutico en el distrito de placer. Un día, provocado por un desayuno servido en la Casa Verdigris, Maomao siente una anomalía y comienza a investigar su verdadera naturaleza. Mientras tanto, Jinshi, que ha revelado su verdadera identidad como el hermano imperial y ha comenzado a enfrentar sus pesadas responsabilidades, está profundamente preocupado por la fina

entries.title: TOUGEN ANKI: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc
entries.description: After battling in Kyoto and Nerima, the Rasetsu Academy students have grown stronger. But Yaoroshi leaves the academy to join the Oni Brigade for their "the total eradication of the Momotaro." When Shiki realizes that they also target noncombatants, he sets out after Yaoroshi to bring him back. Meanwhile in Nikko, there's a research facility for horrific experiments atop the old Kegon Falls… (Source: REMOW)
entries.description_es: Después de luchar en Kioto y Nerima, los estudiantes de la Academia Rasetsu se han hecho más fuertes. Pero Yaoroshi deja la academia para unirse a la Brigada Oni por su "erración total del Momotaro". Cuando Shiki se da cuenta de que también apuntan a los no combatientes, se pone después de Yaoroshi para traerlo de vuelta. Mientras tanto, en Nikko, hay una instalación de investigación para experimentos horribles en la antigua Kegon Falls... (Fuente: REMOW)

entries.title: Welsh & Shedar
entries.description: The story of Aoki Denshou Welsh & Shedar follows Welsh, a teenage boy from the country who loves to cook, and Shedar, a young prince who is destined to become king one day. When the two young men with very different lives are thrown together by a chance encounter, the wheels of fate begin to turn, and soon they must work together to bring about a peaceful future by stopping a cruel despot from conquering the world. (Source: Crunchyroll)
entries.description_es: La historia de Aoki Denshou Welsh " Shedar sigue a Welsh, un adolescente del país que ama cocinar, y a Shedar, un joven príncipe que está destinado a ser rey un día. Cuando los dos jóvenes con vidas muy diferentes son lanzados juntos por un encuentro casual, las ruedas del destino comienzan a girar, y pronto deben trabajar juntos para traer un futuro pacífico al detener un cruel déspota de conquistar el mundo. (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

entries.title: Pan Dorobou
entries.description: Based on Keiko Shibata's picture book "Pan Dorobou" (Bread Thief). The picture books center on a piece of bread that also steals bread from bakeries in the city. (Source: Anime News Network, edited)
entries.description_es: Basado en el libro de fotos de Keiko Shibata "Pan Dorobou" (Bread Thief). Los libros de fotos se centran en un pedazo de pan que también roba pan de panaderías en la ciudad. (Fuente: Anime News Network, editado)

entries.title: Mazenchu
entries.description: Mazenchu is set in a school where all kinds of food can live out their youth and form friendships, rivalries, and bittersweet romances. (Source: Anime News Network)
entries.description_es: Mazenchu está en una escuela donde todo tipo de comida puede vivir su juventud y formar amistades, rivalidades y romances amargos. (Fuente: Anime News Network)

entries.title: Black Clover Season 2
entries.description: As tyranny engulfs the Clover Kingdom, Asta and the Magic Knights launch a desperate raid on the Spade Kingdom to rescue their squad captains from the Dark Triad. But their mission leads them into a brutal battle against forces beyond anything they’ve ever faced. Now, Asta must rise above impossible odds to protect his friends and honor the promise he made to Yuno. (Source: Crunchyroll)
entries.description_es: A medida que la tiranía envuelve el Reino de Clover, Asta y los Caballeros Mágicos lanzan una redada desesperada en el Reino de Spade para rescatar a sus capitanes de la Tribu Oscura. Pero su misión los lleva a una batalla brutal contra las fuerzas más allá de cualquier cosa que hayan enfrentado. Ahora, Asta debe elevarse por encima de las probabilidades imposibles de proteger a sus amigos y honrar la promesa que hizo a Yuno. (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

entries.title: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc
entries.description: Sequel to Tokyo Revengers: Tenjiku-hen .
entries.description_es: Secuela de los Revengers de Tokio: Tenjiku-hen.

entries.title: A Tale of the Secret Saint
entries.description: Fia always dreamed of becoming a knight. Born into a family of knights, she’s the least talented among them, but she still clutches to her hope and trains with everything she has. When the day comes for her to slay a small demon and prove her worth, she ends up face to face with a dragon instead! A deadly injury makes her life flash before her eyes…and she suddenly remembers her former life, when she was a powerful Saint in a bygone era who defeated the Demon King. That life ended in pain because of who she was, making her fear ever becoming a Saint again. Now that the magic from her previous life has been rekindled, she may become a more powerful knight than she ever dreamed–if only she can survive long enough! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: The series streamed a week in advance on ABEMA, Prime Video, and Crunchyroll starting with episode 2 released alongside episode 1.
entries.description_es: Fia siempre soñó con convertirse en un caballero. Nacida en una familia de caballeros, es la menos talentosa entre ellos, pero todavía se aferra a su esperanza y trenes con todo lo que tiene. Cuando llega el día para que mate a un pequeño demonio y pruebe su valor, termina cara a cara con un dragón en su lugar! Una herida mortal hace que su vida parpadee ante sus ojos... y de repente recuerda su vida anterior, cuando era un poderoso santo en una era pasada que venció al Rey demonio. Esa vida terminó con dolor por lo que era, haciendo que su miedo vuelva a ser un santo. Ahora que la magia de su anterior

entries.title: Romelia War Chronicle
entries.description: Romelia and her party succeed in defeating the Demon King Zelgis, though Prince Henri’s reckless charge forces them into a grueling battle. In the aftermath, Romelia is branded "dead weight" for not fighting directly, and the Prince unilaterally breaks off their engagement. Denied a place in the victory celebrations, Romelia returns home, only to be met with cold indifference from her family and society. Yet, she refuses to break. She has already set her sights on the path that lies ahead. (Source: Crunchyroll) Note: Romelia War Chronicle was streamed 2 days in advance of the TV broadcast on AnimeTimes, U-NEXT, and Netflix beginning October 3, 2026. Regular broadcasting began on October 5, 2026.
entries.description_es: Romelia y su partido tienen éxito en derrotar al Rey demonio Zelgis, aunque la carga imprudente del príncipe Henri los obliga a una batalla agotadora. Después, Romelia se marca "peso muerto" por no luchar directamente, y el Príncipe unilateralmente rompe su compromiso. Denegado un lugar en las celebraciones de la victoria, Romelia vuelve a casa, sólo para ser conocido con indiferencia fría de su familia y sociedad. Sin embargo, se niega a romper. Ella ya ha puesto sus ojos en el camino que está por delante. (Fuente: Crunchyroll) Nota: Romelia War Chronicle fue transmitido 2 días antes de la emisión de televisión en A

entries.title: #I'm Looking For a Zombie
entries.description: It may be a ruined city ravaged by zombies, but to Aki and her friends, it’s amazing! Having grown up only hearing stories of the old world and the mysterious outbreak that wiped out humanity, she sets off with her childhood friends in search of her missing father. Things quickly become a fight for survival outside the safety of their small village, yet they’ve never felt more alive. (Source: Crunchyroll)
entries.description_es: Puede ser una ciudad arruinada devastada por zombis, pero para Aki y sus amigos, ¡es increíble! Habiendo crecido sólo escuchando historias del viejo mundo y el misterioso brote que borró a la humanidad, se pone con sus amigos de la infancia en busca de su padre desaparecido. Las cosas se convierten rápidamente en una lucha por la supervivencia fuera de la seguridad de su pequeño pueblo, sin embargo nunca se han sentido más vivos. (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

entries.title: Gensou Suikoden
entries.description: Two young boys... the hero, Riliu, and his best friend Jowy, were members of a youth brigade of their home nation, the Highland Kingdom - a powerful military nation located in the north-east of the Dunan region. The two of them looked up at the same starry skies, slept in the same tent, and believed in the same future. Once the fighting was over, and the night ended, their daily lives were sure to return. Contrary to their hopes, the two boys become swept up in the whirlpool of fate, guided by the flames of war. The powerless boys reached for, and grasped immense power. As the 108 stars shine brightly in the murky horizon, the boys step forward, each with their own beliefs for an answer-less question. (Source: Official Website, translated) Note: The first episode aired with a runtime of ~50 minutes as opposed to the standard 24 minute long episode.
entries.description_es: Dos jóvenes... el héroe, Riliu, y su mejor amigo Jowy, eran miembros de una brigada juvenil de su nación natal, el Reino de Highland, una poderosa nación militar situada en el noreste de la región de Dunan. Los dos miraron hacia arriba los mismos cielos estrellados, durmieron en la misma tienda, y creyeron en el mismo futuro. Una vez que la pelea terminó, y la noche terminó, sus vidas diarias estaban seguras de volver. Contrariamente a sus esperanzas, los dos chicos se arrastran en el torbellino del destino, guiados por las llamas de la guerra. Los chicos impotentes alcanzaron y captaron un inmenso poder. Como brillan las 108 estrellas

entries.title: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom
entries.description: At the heart of a continent of eight kingdoms lies the Marronnier Kingdom. Its general, Baribara, has seven sons, each with a unique gift and serving as a knight commander. Bound by a single noble cause of heroically rescuing a princess someday, the brothers set out as goodwill ambassadors to the seven neighboring kingdoms. What encounters, trials, and destinies await them in these unknown lands? (Source: Amazon Prime Video)
entries.description_es: En el corazón de un continente de ocho reinos se encuentra el Reino Marronnier. Su general, Baribara, tiene siete hijos, cada uno con un regalo único y servir como comandante caballero. Heridos por una única causa noble de rescatar heroicamente a una princesa algún día, los hermanos se establecieron como embajadores de buena voluntad a los siete reinos vecinos. ¿Qué encuentros, pruebas y destinos les esperan en estas tierras desconocidas? (Fuente: Amazon Prime Video)

entries.title: VERTEX FORCE
entries.description: Akira lives a peaceful life with his older sister Haruka and his mother, who runs a cafe. The family however harbors a secret — Haruka has inherited a power from her father called "Engine," and she hides that power from others. Akira on the other hand has not inherited his father's power, and he has an inferiority complex about it. Amidst this, strange events start happening around the world. (Source: Anime News Network)
entries.description_es: Akira vive una vida pacífica con su hermana mayor Haruka y su madre, que dirige un café. Sin embargo, la familia alberga un secreto — Haruka ha heredado un poder de su padre llamado "Engine", y esconde ese poder de otros. Akira, por otro lado, no ha heredado el poder de su padre, y tiene un complejo de inferioridad. En medio de esto, acontecimientos extraños comienzan a suceder alrededor del mundo. (Fuente: Anime News Network)

entries.title: KERORO☆
entries.description: Sergeant Keroro comes to conquer Earth, only to get captured and stuck living with the Hinata family! (Source: Crunchyroll)
entries.description_es: ¡El sargento Keroro viene a conquistar la Tierra, sólo para ser capturado y atrapado viviendo con la familia Hinata! (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

entries.title: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
entries.description: This is Fujinasu Academy, a private high school with top-achieving students located on the outskirts of town. High School 1st-Year Ume Mizunoe has excellent grades in Japanese language class and has received multiple literary awards. However, his terrible grades in the sciences are affecting his ability to move up a grade. To avoid repeating a year, he becomes a member of the student council to improve his academic standing. However, in the student council, he meets the charismatic yet sullen student council president Kotobuki Hisako, and the scary yet kind and refined treasurer, Arisu Terui. Other members include a cheeky and cute boy, Tan Otori, and Komaro Michinoku, the admin who's like a small abandoned cat. This is the start of a slapstick, heartful, rom-com about a busy student council full of cute, mismatched, and quirky students! (Source: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! Official Site)
entries.description_es: Esta es la Academia Fujinasu, una escuela secundaria privada con estudiantes de primer nivel ubicados en las afueras de la ciudad. High School 1er año Ume Mizunoe tiene excelentes calificaciones en la clase de idioma japonés y ha recibido múltiples premios literarios. Sin embargo, sus calificaciones terribles en las ciencias están afectando su capacidad de avanzar en un grado. Para evitar repetir un año, se convierte en miembro del consejo estudiantil para mejorar su posición académica. Sin embargo, en el estudio

entries.title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
entries.description: Sato Takahiro was an ordinary office worker and hobbyist gamer until the day he woke up on a spaceship–one that strangely resembled a craft from a favorite space-shooter game. With a decked-out ship, a crew full of babes, and a fantastic universe to explore, he's going to make the most of his good luck and create the life he's always dreamed of! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
entries.description_es: Sato Takahiro era un trabajador de oficina ordinario y aficionado al juego hasta el día en que se despertó en una nave espacial – una que extrañamente se parecía a una nave de un juego favorito de tiro espacial. Con un barco desguace, una tripulación llena de chicas, y un universo fantástico para explorar, él va a aprovechar al máximo su buena suerte y crear la vida que siempre ha soñado con! (Fuente: Seven Seas Entertainment)

entries.title: Aoashi Season 2
entries.description: Aoi Ashito’s game has now earned him a spot on the A team, but he is quickly overwhelmed by his harsh new reality. Surrounded by elite players like Kuribayashi and Akutsu, practices are just as merciless as the matches. In this U-18 Premier League of powerhouse talent, Ashito must evolve or be crushed, if he’s ever to be acknowledged. (Source: Crunchyroll)
entries.description_es: El juego de Aoi Ashito ahora le ha ganado un lugar en el equipo A, pero rápidamente está abrumado por su dura nueva realidad. Rodeado de jugadores de élite como Kuribayashi y Akutsu, las prácticas son tan misericordiosos como los partidos. En esta U-18 Premier League de talento de la central eléctrica, Ashito debe evolucionar o ser aplastado, si alguna vez es reconocido. (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

entries.title: Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I’ll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest!
entries.description: If there's one thing you can never have enough of in a world of RPG-style swords and sorcery, it's magic points! Whether you're fueling spells, techniques, or showing off an incredible ability, you've gotta spend those points to do real damage. But what if you run out? Lent is part of the up-and-coming party known as the “Skypiercers,” and thanks to his unique Gift, he can loan massive amounts of magic to others. No MP? No problem with Lent around! Except, now that his companions have become formidable heroes (thanks to his skill), his usefulness is questioned. Kicked out of the group, Lent is furious…until he discovers a hidden power to his Gift. Now, with his adorably devious fairy partner, he's going to claw back every last scrap of magic from his former party—with interest! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
entries.description_es: Si hay una cosa que nunca puedes tener suficiente en un mundo de espadas y brujería estilo RPG, ¡es puntos mágicos! Si estás alimentando hechizos, técnicas o mostrando una habilidad increíble, tienes que gastar esos puntos para hacer daño real. ¿Y si te escapas? La Cuaresma es parte de la fiesta de llegada conocida como los "Skypiercers", y gracias a su regalo único, puede prestar enormes cantidades de magia a otros. ¿Sin MP? ¡No hay problema con la Cuaresma! entries.title: Even Though I'm a Super Timid Noble Girl, I Accepted the Bet From My Cunning Fiancé
entries.description: I was reborn as a villainous daughter in a reverse harem otome game. After being sick with a high fever at the age of 10, Pia Rockwell suddenly remembered her past life as a university student in Japan. But far from going down the villainess route, all this super timid girl wants is to finally use her knowledge from when she was a grad student studying to get her doctorate in paleontology. Her ultimate goal is to become a commoner, excavate fossils, build a museum and then become a curator. So in order to escape the villainess route and avoid being deported by her fiancé during the graduation ball, Pia decides to avoid the upcoming hurt and heartache and asks to break off her engagement to Rufus, the Prime Minister's son. But will her cunning fiancé let her go that easily?
entries.description_es: Renací como una hija villana en un juego de harem otome inverso. Después de enfermarse con fiebre alta a los 10 años, Pia Rockwell de repente recordó su vida pasada como estudiante universitaria en Japón. Pero lejos de ir por la ruta del villano, todo lo que esta chica súper tímida quiere es finalmente utilizar su conocimiento de cuando era una estudiante de posgrado que estudiaba para obtener su doctorado en paleontología. Su objetivo final es convertirse en un común, excavar fósiles, construir un museo y luego convertirse en un curador. Así que para escapar de la ruta del villano y evitar ser deportado por su prometido durante la graduación

entries.title: TANK CHAIR
entries.description: Shizuka takes on the most dangerous of assassin jobs, but she's not the one doing the killing. Rather, it's her brother, Nagi, a strong assassin who took a bullet to protect his sister, leaving him in a comatose state and having to use a wheelchair. However, Shizuka has figured out the key to waking her brother up: he must be faced with killing intent! Thus begins a violent journey of recovery, battling the most dangerous foes! (Source: Kodansha USA)
entries.description_es: Shizuka se ocupa de los trabajos más peligrosos de los asesinos, pero ella no es la que hace el asesinato. Más bien, es su hermano, Nagi, un asesino fuerte que tomó una bala para proteger a su hermana, dejarlo en estado en coma y tener que usar una silla de ruedas. Sin embargo, Shizuka ha descubierto la clave para despertar a su hermano: ¡debe enfrentarse con la intención de matar! Así comienza un viaje violento de recuperación, luchando contra los enemigos más peligrosos! (Fuente: Kodansha USA)

entries.title: Uncle's Obsession with Cute Things
entries.description: By day, Mitsutaka Oji is the handsome, dependable boss everyone admires. By night, he dotes on his favorite mascot, Pugtaro, and indulges his secret obsession with all things cute! He's kept his double life hidden for years—but one unexpected encounter turns everything upside down and forces Oji to face his feelings head-on! (Source: Crunchyroll)
entries.description_es: Al día, Mitsutaka Oji es el guapo y confiable jefe que todos admiran. Por la noche, hace su mascota favorita, Pugtaro, y complace su obsesión secreta con todas las cosas lindas! Ha mantenido su doble vida escondida durante años, pero un encuentro inesperado lo vuelve todo al revés y obliga a Oji a enfrentar sus sentimientos. (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

entries.title: Yuruyuru Zukan
entries.description: Gakken's hugely popular illustrated encyclopedia series, which everyone can enjoy with its laid-back four-panel comics, is finally being adapted into a TV anime! Discover surprising aspects and fun facts about living creatures—full of secrets that will make you say, "Wow!" Enjoy this new kind of anime that makes even scary things fun and easy to watch, with its cute art style. (Source: Official Site, translated)
entries.description_es: La popular y popular serie de enciclopedias ilustradas de Gakken, que todos pueden disfrutar con sus cómics de cuatro paneles, finalmente se está adaptando a un anime de televisión! Descubre aspectos sorprendentes y hechos divertidos sobre los seres vivientes, llenos de secretos que te harán decir: "¡Wow!" Disfruta de este nuevo tipo de anime que hace que las cosas aterradoras sean divertidas y fáciles de ver, con su estilo de arte lindo. (Fuente: Sitio oficial, traducido)

entries.title: Raccoon Dog & Fox
entries.description: The story centers on the daily lives of a raccoon dog who is not quite with it and a mischievous fox who likes to tease the raccoon dog. The two are close friends who live together on a mountain. Their other friends include a wolf, a bear, a rabbit, and birds. (Source: Anime News Network)
entries.description_es: La historia se centra en la vida diaria de un perro de mapache que no está bien con él y un zorro malicioso que le gusta burlar al perro de mapache. Los dos son amigos cercanos que viven juntos en una montaña. Sus otros amigos incluyen un lobo, un oso, un conejo y aves. (Fuente: Anime News Network)

entries.title: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion!
entries.description: “Make me a love potion.” And with that single sentence, the Good Witch of the Lake’s secret crush on the dashing Sir Harij ends in heartbreak. Still, when he promises to help her gather the ingredients, Rose is thrilled at the chance to gaze upon a man she’d normally never get to interact with. She learns to brace her pounding heart for their usual stilted conversations…but what is she to do when he inexplicably shows up at her doorstep with bread and a jar of apple butter? (Source: Yen Press)
entries.description_es: Hazme una poción de amor. Y con esa sola frase, la Buena Bruja del amor secreto del lago sobre el desgarrador Sir Harij termina en la ruptura del corazón. Sin embargo, cuando promete ayudarla a reunir los ingredientes, Rose está emocionada por la oportunidad de mirar a un hombre con el que normalmente nunca podría interactuar. Ella aprende a jactar su corazón por sus conversaciones usuales inclinadas... pero ¿qué va a hacer cuando aparece inexplicablemente en su puerta con bre

entries.title: I'm Dating a Dark Summoner
entries.description: Amona’s a dark summoner with demonic powers. Roni’s a devout priest who’s way too uptight. By all rights, they should hate each other. Instead, they end up fast-tracking their enemies-to-lovers arc with a one-night stand that somehow insists on becoming a recurring event. Now they must hide their situationship from the rest of the party while denying their growing attraction to one another, all while dealing with an imp who’s far too invested in their love life. (Source: HIDIVE)
entries.description_es: Amona es un llamador oscuro con poderes demoníacos. Roni es un sacerdote devota que está demasiado tenso. Por todos los derechos, deben odiarse. En lugar de eso, terminan acelerando su arco de enemigos a amantes con un stand de una noche que de alguna manera insiste en convertirse en un evento recurrente. Ahora deben ocultar su nave de situación del resto del partido mientras niegan su creciente atracción entre sí, mientras tratan con un imp que está demasiado invertido en su vida amorosa. (Fuente: HIDIVE)

entries.title: PSYREN
entries.description: One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious “red phone card” left behind in a public telephone booth. A few days later, his childhood friend and classmate, Sakurako Amamiya—who possessed the same card—suddenly vanishes without a trace. In search of her, Ageha finds himself drawn into the rumors surrounding a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances, said to be the work of a secret organization known only as “Psyren.” When he accesses the group, a deadly game begins—one that will change his fate forever. (Source: PSYЯEN Official Site)
entries.description_es: Un día, la secundaria Ageha Yoshina recoge una misteriosa “tarjeta de teléfono roja” que queda atrás en una cabina telefónica pública. Unos días más tarde, su amigo de la infancia y compañero de clase, Sakurako Amamiya, que poseía la misma carta, desaparecen sin dejar rastro. En busca de ella, Ageha se encuentra dibujado en los rumores que rodean una cadena nacional de misteriosas desapariciones, dijo que es obra de una organización secreta conocida sólo como “Psyren”. Cuando accede al grupo, comienza un juego mortal, uno que cambiará su destino para siempre. (Fuente: Sitio Oficial de PSYHUEN)

entries.title: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin?
entries.description: Office worker Akira Yagami’s altruistic nature usually gets him the short end of the stick. When he dies after saving a kid from oncoming traffic...he reincarnates in another world as a goblin?! Normally, goblins only live for seven days, but Akira’s newfound powers let him defy the species’ normal life span...and are the key to his path to becoming the strongest goblin ever! (Source: Yen Press) Note: Tensei Goblin Dakedo Shitsumon Aru? is streaming 1 week in advance of the TV broadcast on ABEMA and Prime Video beginning with episode 2 on October 5th, 2026
entries.description_es: La naturaleza altruista del trabajador de oficina Akira Yagami generalmente le consigue el extremo corto del palo. Cuando muere después de salvar a un niño del tráfico entrante... ¿reencarna en otro mundo como un duende? Normalmente, los duendes sólo viven durante siete días, pero los nuevos poderes de Akira le permiten desafiar el período de vida normal de la especie... ¡y son la clave de su camino para convertirse en el más fuerte de todos los tiempos! (Fuente: Yen Press) Nota: Tensei Goblin Dakedo Sitsumon Aru?

entries.title: My Girlfriend's Friend
entries.description: For the first time in my life, I have a girlfriend. But her friend tempts me with a body that's so seductive... What would you do if your girlfriend's friend came on to you like this? (Source: Yanmaga, translated)
entries.description_es: Por primera vez en mi vida, tengo una novia. Pero su amiga me tienta con un cuerpo tan seductor... ¿Qué harías si el amigo de tu novia viniera a ti así? (Fuente: Yanmaga, traducido)

entries.title: Now That I Can Control Reality With A Mouse Cursor, I'm Gonna Click Away On The Girls!
entries.description: What if you could control reality with a mouse cursor? One day during class, Takumi— an otaku — notices his mouse cursor has sprung out of the screen. Panicked, he asks his childhood friend Mone, sitting next to him, to take a look, only to be brushed off... Once Takumi realizes he could actually control it himself, he uses the mouse cursor— visible only to him— to slip it in between Mone's clothes and starts clicking away... Here's Japan’s (probably) first new genre of romcom, "Clicking Away at a Gyaru Who's Mean to Otakus with a Mouse Cursor"! (Source: Official Site) Note: Episode 1 receives an advanced distribution on AnimeFesta on September 11th, 2026. The start date reflects the start of the regular series broadcasting.
entries.description_es: ¿Y si pudiera controlar la realidad con un cursor del ratón? Un día durante la clase, Takumi, un otaku, nota que el cursor del ratón ha salido de la pantalla. Panicked, pide a su amigo de la infancia Mone, sentado junto a él, para echar un vistazo, sólo para ser cepillado... Una vez que Takumi se da cuenta de que podía controlarlo él mismo, utiliza el cursor del ratón — visible sólo para él— para deslizarlo entre la ropa de Mone y empieza a hacer clic... Aquí está Japón (probablemente) primer nuevo género de romcom, "Haciendo clic en Away en un Gyaru Who's Mean a Otakus con un cursor Mouse"! (Fuente: Sitio Oficial) Nota: Episodio 1 recibe

entries.title: From Far Away
entries.description: On her way home from school one day, Noriko is unexpectedly plunged into a strange and extraordinary fantasy world. Her troubles compound exponentially when she is rescued and befriended by a handsome young man by the name of Izark. He may be brave and courageous, but inside Izark lurks the darkest evil imaginable. And according to an ancient prophecy, Noriko possesses the power to unleash that evil. Now, inexorably bound together, these two unlikely allies must navigate a world both wondrous and hostile. (Source: VIZ Media)
entries.description_es: En su camino a casa desde la escuela un día, Noriko se sumergió inesperadamente en un extraño y extraordinario mundo de fantasía. Sus problemas se complican exponencialmente cuando es rescatada y amigada por un joven guapo por el nombre de Izark. Puede ser valiente y valiente, pero dentro de Izark se esconde el mal más oscuro imaginable. Y según una profecía antigua, Noriko posee el poder de desencadenar ese mal. Ahora, inexorablemente unidos, estos dos aliados improbables deben navegar por un mundo maravilloso y hostil. (Fuente: VIZ Media)

entries.description: A weekly mini anime shown with each episode of Kanojo no Tomodachi exclusively on the AT-X broadcast of the TV anime and online on OceanVeil.

entries.title: JK Dark Summoner to Deki......Dei Nai!?
entries.description: A weekly mini anime shown with each episode of Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru exclusively on the AT-X broadcast of the TV anime and online on Abema.
entries.description_es: Un mini anime semanal mostrado con cada episodio de Dark Summoner a Dekiteiru exclusivamente en la transmisión AT-X del anime de TV y en línea en Abema.

entries.title: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden
entries.description: A great hero lies undefeated on her deathbed, regretting that she never found a foe who could take her down. She never intended to meet her fate anywhere other than on the battlefield, and her peaceful demise has her wishing desperately that things could have been different... But when she suddenly comes to in the body of the young, frail Nia Liston, she’s got an all-new fight ahead of her. Nia is a sickly child, meaning she has a long way to go before she’s in fighting form. Now that she’s been given a second shot at life, however, she’s determined to get what she wants. She’s going to live—and die—for battle this time! Make way for the Merciless Maiden! (Source: J-Novel Club)
entries.description_es: Un gran héroe está invicto en su lecho de muerte, lamentando que nunca haya encontrado a un enemigo que pudiera derribarla. Nunca quiso encontrar su destino en otro lugar que en el campo de batalla, y su pacífica desaparición tiene su deseo desesperadamente de que las cosas podrían haber sido diferentes... Pero cuando de repente viene al cuerpo de la joven y frágil Nia Liston, tiene una nueva lucha por delante de ella. Nia es una niña enferma, lo que significa que tiene un largo camino por recorrer

entries.title: The Cold Sato-san is Only Sweet to Me
entries.description: Sato-san is the unattainable flower of the class. She is always cold and curt with classmates, but only I know she's actually very cute when she smiles, even if she's not much of a photographer. Oshio-kun is friendly and lively, but only I know he works at his family's cafe after school. He does a great job with the cafe's SNS account, and his mischievous smile makes my heart skip a beat! Innocent and sweet, but sometimes frustrating, this is a 120%-pure fluffy story about two people falling in love for the first time.
entries.description_es: Sato-san es la flor inalcanzable de la clase. Ella siempre tiene frío y curtimiento con compañeros de clase, pero sólo sé que es muy linda cuando sonríe, incluso si no es mucho de fotógrafo. Oshio-kun es amistoso y animado, pero sólo sé que trabaja en el café de su familia después de la escuela. Hace un gran trabajo con la cuenta SNS de la cafetería, y su mala sonrisa hace que mi corazón se salte un latido! Innocente y dulce, pero a veces frustrante, esto es un

entries.title: MAGICAL GIRL RAISING PROJECT restart
entries.description: Some magical girls fight. Others do not. Chosen by the mysterious Land of Magic, which exists unbeknownst to the rest of the world, magical girls are each granted a unique power. Pechka, whose magic makes food delicious, is forced to take part in a mysterious virtual game together with 16 unfamiliar magical girls, each with her own distinctive personality. It was supposed to be a safe training exercise designed to improve their magical abilities. But instead, it marks the beginning of a carefully orchestrated nightmare - a forbidden trial. A new Magical Girl Raising Project has begun. (Source: OceanVeil)
entries.description_es: Algunas chicas mágicas pelean. Otros no. Elegido por la misteriosa Tierra de la Magia, que existe poco conocida por el resto del mundo, las chicas mágicas cada una tienen un poder único. Pechka, cuya magia hace deliciosa la comida, se ve obligada a participar en un misterioso juego virtual junto con 16 chicas mágicas desconocidas, cada una con su propia personalidad distintiva. Se suponía que era un ejercicio de entrenamiento seguro diseñado para mejorar sus habilidades mágicas. Pero en cambio, marca el comienzo de una pesadilla cuidadosamente orquestada - un juicio prohibido. Ha comenzado un nuevo proyecto de Raising Girl Magical. (Fuente:

entries.title: Super Psychic Policeman Chojo
entries.description: The ultimate police duo is here to keep the peace! Rookie officer Nao just joined the force. She’s got a black belt in judo and earned the nickname “Gorilla” for her insane strength. Then there’s her partner Chojo, who wields every psychic power imaginable. But for a guy who can read minds, he still can’t seem to read the room. Now, these two are taking on crime together in Chinjuku. (Source: Crunchyroll)
entries.description_es: ¡El último dúo policial está aquí para mantener la paz! El oficial novato Nao acaba de unirse a la fuerza. Tiene un cinturón negro en judo y ganó el apodo "Gorilla" por su fuerza loca. Luego está su compañero Chojo, quien controla todo poder psíquico imaginable. Pero para un tipo que puede leer mentes, todavía no puede leer la habitación. Estos dos están cometiendo un crimen juntos en Chinjuku. (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

entries.title: Battle Spirits [Re] Zekkai No Ku
entries.description: Keio 3, Hinomoto, Eito. As the Bakumatsu throws Japan into turmoil, young Kuu Bashin dreams of becoming stronger through Standard Battle Spirits. His world changes when he encounters Ajara Zetsu, a wandering samurai and formidable Eternal Battler pursued by anti-shogunate forces. As the worlds of Standard and Eternal Battle collide, Kuu is pulled into Zetsu’s journey—and sets history in motion. (Source: Crunchyroll)
entries.description_es: Keio 3, Hinomoto, Eito. A medida que el Bakumatsu lanza a Japón en agitación, el joven Kuu Bashin sueña con volverse más fuerte a través de los Espíritus de Batalla Estándar. Su mundo cambia cuando se encuentra con Ajara Zetsu, un samurai errante y formidable Batalla Eterna perseguido por fuerzas antihogunadas. Mientras los mundos de la batalla estándar y eterna chocan, Kuu es llevado al viaje de Zetsu, y pone la historia en movimiento. (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

entries.title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
entries.description: Rein, an enchanter, is suddenly expelled from his guild one day. But instead of despairing, he declares, “Now I can do anything!” and begins reclaiming the massive number of enhancement points he once poured into his guildmates’ gear, setting off on a brand-new path as an adventurer. Gathering around him are people carrying wounds that don’t fade easily: a genius adventurer who shut her heart after her party was slaughtered, a warrior who lost her family, and an assassin raised from childhood to kill. Yet Rein never rejects their pasts or their scars—he accepts them all with bright, straightforward warmth. The stage is a unique fantasy world where Uzis, slingshots, and even yakuza exist side by side. But in this world, the more people rely on convenient technology, the more their magic weakens, and adventurers grow fragile. Intelligent, vicious monsters roam freely, while in the underworld, outlaws bare their greed and ambition as schemes and betrayals intertwine. In a world where ideals and justice are easily crushed, adventurers fight on with nothing but their magic and their convictions. This is the story of those who have lost their place in the world finding a new way to live. Rein and his companions’ wild, free-spirited second life begins now! (Source: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life Site)
entries.description_es: Rein, un encantador, es expulsado de su gremio un día. Pero en lugar de desesperar, declara, “¡Ahora puedo hacer cualquier cosa!” y comienza a reclamar el enorme número de puntos de mejora que una vez vierte en el equipo de sus compañeros, a partir de un nuevo camino como aventurero. Reunirse a su alrededor son personas que llevan heridas que no se desvanecen fácilmente: un genio aventurero que cerró su corazón después de que su partido fue masacrado, un guerrero que perdió

entries.title: The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2
entries.description: After thwarting a hijacking with beautiful, silver-haired detective Siesta, Kimihiko leads a life of globe-trotting and crime-solving—until Siesta dies. A year later, a new case will open old wounds as it threads murder, conspiracy, and his dead partner! (Source: Crunchyroll)
entries.description_es: Después de frustrar un secuestro con el hermoso detective de pelo plateado Siesta, Kimihiko conduce una vida de ataque mundial y resolución del crimen hasta que Siesta muera. Un año más tarde, un nuevo caso abrirá viejas heridas mientras roza asesinato, conspiración y su compañero muerto! (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

entries.title: The World's Strongest Witch
entries.description: After using her SSS-Rank skill, Internet, to crush her former family’s ambitions, Lorna is free to travel the world. Her next stop is the port town of Aquas, where she hopes to see the sights and chow down on some fresh seafood. But when she arrives, the place is on the brink of destruction thanks to a certain Weekly Quest… Good thing Lorna has the gods on her side! (Source: Crunchyroll)
entries.description_es: Después de usar su habilidad SSS-Rank, Internet, para aplastar las ambiciones de su antigua familia, Lorna es libre de viajar por el mundo. Su próxima parada es la ciudad portuaria de Aquas, donde espera ver los lugares de interés y disfrutar de algunos mariscos frescos. Pero cuando llega, el lugar está al borde de la destrucción gracias a una cierta misión semanal... ¡Qué bueno que Lorna tenga los dioses de su lado! (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

entries.title: Sasaki and Peeps Season 2
entries.description: The second season of Sasaki to Pii-chan .
entries.description_es: La segunda temporada de Sasaki a Pii-chan.

entries.title: Magic Knight Rayearth (2026)
entries.description: Hikaru Shidou, Umi Ryuuzaki, and Fuu Hououji aren't from Cephiro. While on a school field trip to the Tokyo Tower, the three girls' minds are on anything but different worlds filled with magic and wonder. That is, until Princess Emeraude, the Pillar of Cephiro, cries out for the Magic Knights to save her world--and that just happens to be those three! (Source: Crunchyroll)
entries.description_es: Hikaru Shidou, Umi Ryuuzaki, y Fuu Hououji no son de Cephiro. Mientras que en un viaje de campo escolar a la Torre de Tokio, las mentes de las tres chicas están en cualquier cosa excepto mundos diferentes llenos de magia y maravilla. Es decir, hasta que la Princesa Esmeraude, el Pilar de Cephiro, clama por los Caballeros Mágicos para salvar su mundo, ¡y eso resulta que son esos tres! (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

entries.title: A Returner's Magic Should be Special Season 2
entries.description: In a land dominated by the formidable Shadow Worlds, most of humanity has been destroyed. To rescue their planet from impending doom, six brave heroes fight a perilous battle…and fail. But there’s a glimpse of hope when Desir, one of the last mages, is suddenly sent back in time 13 years! Now armed with knowledge of the grim future, can he alter the course of history and save the world? (Source: Crunchyroll)
entries.description_es: En una tierra dominada por los formidables Mundos Sombríos, la mayoría de la humanidad ha sido destruida. Para rescatar a su planeta de la muerte inminente, seis héroes valientes luchan una batalla peligrosa... y fracasan. Pero hay una mirada de esperanza cuando Desir, una de las últimas magras, es de repente enviado en el tiempo 13 años! Ahora armado con conocimiento del futuro sombrío, ¿puede alterar el curso de la historia y salvar el mundo? (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

entries.title: Girls und Panzer: Motto Love Love Sakusen desu!
entries.description: A deep dive into the untold daily lives and the inter-school interactions of the Ooarai Girls' team and the other students (along with the colorful characters that surround them) who are wholeheartedly dedicated to the way of the tank! (Source: Official Website, translated) Note: The series had a four-part theatrical pre-screening in Japan starting in December 2025. Regular TV broadcast began in October 2026. • Part 1 releasing theatrically on December 26, 2025. • Part 2 releasing theatrically on January 30, 2026. • Part 3 releasing theatrically on March 6, 2026. • Part 4 releasing theatrically on April 10, 2026.
entries.description_es: Una profunda inmersión en la vida cotidiana incalculable y las interacciones entre escuelas del equipo de Ooarai Girls y los demás estudiantes (junto con los personajes coloridos que los rodean) que están totalmente dedicados al camino del tanque! (Fuente: Página Web Oficial, traducido) Nota: La serie tenía un pre-pantalla de cuatro partes en Japón a partir de diciembre de 2025. La televisión regular comenzó en octubre de 2026. • Parte 1 liberando teatralmente el 26 de diciembre de 2025. • Parte 2 liberando teatralmente el 30 de enero de 2026. • Parte 3 liberando teatralmente el 6 de marzo de 2026. • Parte 4 liberando teatricall

entries.title: Dandivine
entries.description: The story takes place 20 years after the robot Dandivine defeated the mysterious Aposdoll. The world is now in peace. However, toy manufacturer Kasuga, who relied on its toys of merchandise of Dandivine, has fallen into decline. Thus, Kasuga's president Genjuro Shijima prayed for Dandivine's revival, and the Aposdoll suddenly returned. High school student Gekiha Shijima gets an invitation from his uncle Yusaku Kuroiwa, the former main pilot of Dandivine, to pilot the giant robot himself. (Source: Anime News Network)
entries.description_es: La historia tiene lugar 20 años después de que el robot Dandivine derrotara al misterioso Aposdoll. El mundo está ahora en paz. Sin embargo, el fabricante de juguetes Kasuga, que dependía de sus juguetes de mercadería de Dandivine, ha caído en declive. Así, el presidente de Kasuga, Genjuro Shijima, oró por el renacimiento de Dandivine, y el Aposdoll de repente regresó. El estudiante de secundaria Gekiha Shijima recibe una invitación de su tío Yusaku Kuroiwa, el ex piloto principal de Dandivine, para pilotar el robot gigante mismo. (Fuente: Anime News Network)

entries.title: Firefly Wedding
entries.description: On the surface, Satoko has it all—she’s beautiful, the daughter of a nobleman, and at a prime age for marriage. Unfortunately, she is also quite ill and only has a short time left to live. Before she can secure a marriage that will redeem her worth in her family’s eyes, she finds herself the target of the mysterious assassin Shinpei, and her plans are put in jeopardy. In order to save herself, she makes a desperate proposal—of marriage! When it comes to love, however, Shinpei takes “until death do we part” seriously. (Source: VIZ Media)
entries.description_es: En la superficie, Satoko lo tiene todo, es hermosa, la hija de un noble, y a una edad temprana para el matrimonio. Desafortunadamente, ella también está bastante enferma y sólo tiene un corto tiempo para vivir. Antes de que pueda conseguir un matrimonio que redimirá su valor en los ojos de su familia, se encuentra el blanco del misterioso asesino Shinpei, y sus planes están en peligro. ¡Para salvarse, hace una propuesta desesperada de matrimonio! Cuando c

entries.title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World II
entries.description: Once dismissed as the sole ordinary student at the elite Arnold Academy of Sorcery, Ray White—secretly, the Iceblade Sorcerer—has finally earned his place. With a new school year comes a new challenge: The Magicks War, a grand competition pitting teams from rival schools against each other. But an ominous shadow looms over Ray and his friends as the other grand sorcerers plot their next moves. (Source: Crunchyroll)
entries.description_es: Una vez despedido como el único estudiante ordinario de la élite Arnold Academy of Sorcery, Ray White — secretamente, el Hechicero de Iceblade— finalmente ha ganado su lugar. Con un nuevo año escolar surge un nuevo desafío: La Guerra de los Magos, una gran competencia que enfrenta equipos de escuelas rivales entre sí. Pero una sombra ominosa sobre Ray y sus amigos mientras los otros grandes hechiceros trazan sus próximos movimientos. (Fuente: Crunchyroll)

entries.title: A Certain Dark Item
entries.description: This is a story of four girls living in the "Dark Side" of Academy City. In Academy City where "ESP" has been recognized as a general science. Behind the peace, there is a Dark Side organization that undertakes missions that cannot be made public. "ITEM" is an elite unit consisting of four girls. Takitsubo Rikou is able to read and track the AIM fields emitted by those with abilities. Frenda Seivelun, who excels in combat using explosives and traps. Kinuhata Saiai, who can manipulate nitrogen at will and plays a defensive role. And one of the 7 Espers that Academy City is proud of: Mugino Shizuri. They live freely in the darkness of the Academy City, and quietly set their sights on their target...! This is a story of encounter, friendship, and darkness that eventually leads to a terrible incident! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)
entries.description_es: Esta es una historia de cuatro chicas que viven en el "Dark Side" de Academy City. En la Ciudad de la Academia donde el "ESP" ha sido reconocido como una ciencia general. Detrás de la paz, hay una organización del lado oscuro que realiza misiones que no pueden hacerse públicas. "ITEM" es una unidad de élite compuesta por cuatro chicas. Takitsubo Rikou es capaz de leer y rastrear los campos AIM emitidos por aquellos con capacidades. Frenda Seivelun, que destaca en combate utilizando explosivos y trampas. Kinuhata Saiai, que puede manipular el nitrógeno a voluntad y juega un papel defensivo. Y uno de los 7 Espers que Academy City está orgulloso de: Mugino Shiz

entries.title: To You in the Beyond
entries.description: The story centers on a boy named Kazuki Tsukigase, who transfers to a high school on a remote island to get away from anyone who knows him. Kazuki finds out that there is an inlet on the island where people are rumored to disappear. Exploring the inlet, he encounters an unconscious girl. When she comes to after Kazuki takes her to the clinic, she is unable to give out anything about her identity except that she is named Nao, is 16 years old, and whispers the year "1974." (Source: Anime News Network, edited)
entries.description_es: La historia se centra en un chico llamado Kazuki Tsukigase, que se traslada a una escuela secundaria en una isla remota para alejarse de cualquiera que lo conozca. Kazuki descubre que hay una entrada en la isla donde se rumorea que la gente desaparece. Explorando la entrada, se encuentra con una chica inconsciente. Cuando llega después de que Kazuki la lleve a la clínica, no puede dar nada sobre su identidad excepto que se llama Nao, tiene 16 años, y susurra el año 1974. (Fuente: Anime News Network, editado)

entries.title: TETSURYO! Meet With Tetsudou Musume
entries.description: Misaki has often felt the urge to break free from everyday life and set out on a journey somewhere far away. Even though she doesn’t yet know what she wants to become, she longs to find something she can truly be passionate about. At the start of a new chapter on a lively campus, she meets the members of the Railway Travel Research Club—known as the “Tetsuryo Club.” As her world unfolds along the railway lines, Misaki’s heart begins to race with excitement! As TETSUDOU MUSUME celebrates its 20th anniversary, the Tetsuryo Club sets off on a journey through the world where the Railway Girls work, in search of moments of wonder. (Source: Pony Canyon Anime)
entries.description_es: Misaki ha sentido a menudo el impulso de liberarse de la vida cotidiana y de emprender un viaje lejos. A pesar de que todavía no sabe lo que quiere convertirse, ella desea encontrar algo que realmente pueda ser apasionada. Al comienzo de un nuevo capítulo en un animado campus, se reúne con los miembros del Club de Investigación de Viajes Ferroviarios, conocido como el Club Tetsuryo. Mientras su mundo se desarrolla a lo largo de las líneas ferroviarias, el corazón de Misaki comienza a correr con emoción! A medida que TETSUDOU MUSUME celebra su 20 aniversario, el Tetsuryo Club comienza en un viaje por el mundo donde trabajan las Ferrocarriles

entries.title: Girls und Panzer: Saishuushou 5
entries.description: The fifth film in the six-part Girls und Panzer: Saishuushou film series.
entries.description_es: La quinta película de la serie de películas Saishuushou de seis partes.

entries.description: Sequel to Duel Masters LOST: Boukyaku no Taiyou .
entries.description_es: Secuela de Duel Masters LOST: Boukyaku no Taiyou.

entries.title: The Vermilion Mask
entries.description: "The Mask” gives power to anyone who wears it. At times, that means endless possibility, or unimaginable tragedy… Peru, pupil of the legendary mask maker Gaston Roux, becomes controlled by the “Mask of the Warrior God,” and unintentionally kills his friends, and even his own master. In order to prevent this type of tragedy from reoccurring, Peru swears to destroy all of Gaston’s masks that are spread around the world. Confronting the sins that he has committed, he embarks on his voyage. Meeting new friends, then confronting powerful foes. The boy continues on. Until the day he can atone for his sins against his master. (Source: The Vermillion Mask English Site)
entries.description_es: "La máscara" da poder a cualquiera que la use. A veces, eso significa una posibilidad interminable, o una tragedia inimaginable... Perú, alumno del legendario fabricante de máscaras Gaston Roux, se hace controlado por el “Mask del Dios Guerrero”, y mata involuntariamente a sus amigos, e incluso a su propio maestro. Para evitar que este tipo de tragedia vuelva a ocurrir, Perú jura destruir todas las máscaras de Gaston que se extienden alrededor del mundo. Frente a los pecados que ha cometido, se embarca en su viaje. Conocer a nuevos amigos y enfrentar a poderosos enemigos. El chico continúa. Hasta el día que puede expiar por hola

entries.title: HORROR COLLECTOR
entries.description: Urban legends come to life…Everyone’s heard an urban legend before, but few have ever come face-to-face with one. These phenomena are everywhere, existing in the shadows of reality. More and more of them have been appearing in the wake of the faceless kid sighted all over Japan. If you see her or one of the urban legends she brings―pray the boy in the red hood finds you before it’s too late. You won’t stand a chance on your own. But with his help, you may just live to see another day… (Source: Yen Press)
entries.description_es: Las leyendas urbanas cobran vida... Todos han oído una leyenda urbana antes, pero pocos han llegado cara a cara con uno. Estos fenómenos están en todas partes, existentes en las sombras de la realidad. Cada vez más de ellos han estado apareciendo a raíz del niño sin rostro visto por todo Japón. Si la ves o una de las leyendas urbanas que trae, ora al chico en la capucha roja te encuentra antes de que sea demasiado tarde. Usted no tendrá una oportunidad por su cuenta. Pero con su ayuda, puedes vivir para ver otro día... (Fuente: Yen Press)

entries.title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus
entries.description: Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep. Even Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus's overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku. Targeted by Beerus, the strongest being in the universe, Earth is in grave danger. Thus begins an earth-shattering cosmic battle between the God of Destruction and Goku and his alliesa—a conflict that will shake the entire universe. (Source: Official Site) Note: “Enhanced” edition of Dragon Ball Super, featuring a large volume of newly added and redrawn cuts, a reconstructed narrative, and updated visuals for a more immersive and faithful representation of Akira Toriyama’s original manga.
entries.description_es: Han pasado varios años desde la feroz batalla contra Majin Buu, y la Tierra finalmente ha recuperado un breve momento de paz. Al mismo tiempo, Beerus, el Dios de la Destrucción, despierta de su sueño largo y profundo. Incluso Kai y el Supremo Kai, consciente del abrumador poder de Beerus para destruir planetas enteros, ver su despertar con gran miedo... Mientras tanto, Beerus escucha rumores de un Saiyan que venció a Frieza y de repente aparece ante Goku. Meta de cerveza

entries.title: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers
entries.description: RPG player Makoto Takatsuki is hurled into another world with awful skills and stats. But he soon meets a goddess named Noah, who asks him to become her 1st believer in return for blessings. (Source: J-Novel Club)
entries.description_es: El jugador de RPG Makoto Takatsuki es lanzado en otro mundo con terribles habilidades y estadísticas. Pero pronto se encuentra con una diosa llamada Noé, que le pide que se convierta en su primer creyente a cambio de bendiciones. (Fuente: J-Novel Club)
